passive.name: Modular Core
passive.description: While Charged or Supercharged, Ando ignores non-damage effects.

passiveTriggers.note: 'While Charged or Supercharged, Ando ignores non-damage effects.' Modeled as a self-refreshing non_damage_ignore whose duration tracks the remaining charge window; statusApplied is the only reactive hook for the mid-turn charge gain.

effects.note: One random effect of four (~25% each): (A) 10 Affliction to all targets, (B) all targets deal 5 less next turn, (C) all allies +10 Shield, (D) Ando deals 10 more next turn.

passive.name: Capacitor Upgrade
passive.description: Expel Energy deals 5 more damage each time Ando gains Charged or Supercharged. This effect stacks and is removed when Expel Energy is used.

passiveTriggers.note: Each time Ando gains Charged or Supercharged, add a Capacitor Upgrade stack (each stack = +5 Expel Energy damage). Fires exactly on the charge-gain via eventStatusKind (the applied status IS Charged/Supercharged), not merely while holding it.

effect.note: If the skill used is Expel Energy (ando3): deal 5 x current Capacitor Upgrade stacks as bonus damage to its target, then remove all Capacitor Upgrade stacks. No skill-id condition exists, so this is a custom escape hatch.

effects.name: Capacitor Upgrade
effects.note: Each successive Rev generates one more Capacitor Upgrade stack than the last, capped at 3 (tracked by the Rev Uses counter).

passive.name: Conductive Combo
passive.description: Electroblade's Mark effect now lasts for Ando's next three turns.

effect.note: When Ando applies the Electroblade mark, set that mark to last 3 turns (Conductive Combo). Re-set via custom to avoid re-emitting statusApplied that a remove+re-apply would.

effects.note: Targets marked by Rising Geyser replicate all new damage they receive to every other Rising Geyser-marked target (a damage link across marked units).

passive.name: Ionic Cloaking
passive.description: Ando is Stealthed while Supercharged. (He will not trigger enemy effects.)

passiveTriggers.note: While Supercharged, Ando is Stealthed (does not trigger enemy effects). Stealth duration tracks the remaining Supercharged window; statusApplied is the reactive hook for the mid-turn Supercharge.

effects.note: For 2 turns: cast Electroblade (ando1) on any enemy who attempts to become Invulnerable, and cast Flash Step (ando2) on any enemy who uses a Harmful skill. Effects cannot install reactive triggers, so this watch window is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Charge Absorption
passive.description: Whenever Ando's skills gain additional targets, he gains 10 Shield for each extra target affected.

effect.note: When Ando's skill affected more targets than its base targeting would (extra targets from Charged/Supercharged spreads), grant 10 Shield per extra target. 'Extra' count is engine-internal, so this is a custom escape hatch.

effects.note: For 1 turn: any Helpful skill used on the target enemy is reflected to Ando; any damaging skill used on Ando is reflected to the target enemy. This skill is invisible (frozen hidden:true).

passive.name: Laser Edge
passive.description: Enemies marked by Electroblade receive 5 Affliction Damage each turn.

passiveTriggers.note: Electroblade-marked enemies take 5 Affliction each turn — modeled as a permanent 'Laser Edge' DoT applied when the Electroblade mark lands (ticks 5 affliction per Ando turn).

effects.note: Bypasses (dtype piercing + bypass:true = ignores DR AND Shield) vs Electroblade-marked targets; +10 damage vs Shattered enemies. Damage mods still apply (only DR+Shield are bypassed).

passive.name: Lightning Revenant
passive.description: Ando is permanently Isolated. If Ando gains Charged, he heals for 5 Health. If he gains Supercharged, he heals for 10 Health.

passiveTriggers.note: On gaining Charged, heal 5. Fires exactly on the Charged application via eventStatusKind (not merely while holding it).
On gaining Supercharged, heal 10 (fires exactly on the Supercharged application via eventStatusKind).

effects.note: Cannot be stunned (Unstunnable tag). If used while Stunned: Bypasses (piercing) and cannot be Countered or Reflected (uncounterableIf: self has stun).

passive.name: Erratic Programming
passive.description: Ando is permanently Blinded, but he deals 10 Piercing damage to an additional random target whenevery he uses a Harmful skill.

passiveTriggers.note: Harmful-scoping of skillUsed is not enforced (skillUsed carries no class tags); fires on any self skill use.

passive.name: God of Thunder
passive.description: Ando permanently deals 5 additional damage with all of his abilities whenever he uses a Supercharged skill.

passiveTriggers.note: Each time Ando uses a skill while Supercharged, permanently +5 outgoing damage. stacks:true ACCUMULATES the magnitude (+5 -> +10 -> +15) across uses instead of refreshing back to +5.

effects.note: Receives double benefit from God of Thunder: applies Ando's accumulated outgoing_damage_mod (+5 per Supercharged use) a SECOND time to this skill's damage to all enemies (the automatic first application already applied once). No Value ref exposes a status magnitude, so this is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Silent Avenger
passive.description: Ando will immediately become Supercharged if an allied hero is killed. This Supercharge lasts for his next two turns and is not consumed by his abilities.

passiveTriggers.note: When an allied hero dies, Ando immediately becomes Supercharged for his next two turns. The companion 'Silent Avenger' mark (duration 2) both flags the 'not consumed by his abilities' window and is read by Penance.

then.note: During Silent Avenger, first remove all Shield from the target.

passive.name: Choir On High
passive.description: Whenever Ayana uses Chorus, she summons two Angel minions. While either of them is alive, Chorus is permanent. When both Angels are killed, Chorus immediately ends.
passive.note: skillUsed carries no skill-id predicate, so 'uses Chorus' is gated only on sameUnit(eventSource,self) (fires on any self skill use). Angels = summon template 'ayanaangelminion' (unregistered fusion-era minion, so the summoned unit.name falls back to the template id, which the count selector matches). Chorus is made permanent by re-applying its 'Chorus' mark with duration null; the unitDied guard ends it once no Angel minions remain alive.

passive.name: Maiden of Purity
passive.description: Using Chorus or Voice of Glory will heal your most damaged ally for 15 HP.
passive.note: skillUsed has no skill-id predicate, so the Chorus/Voice-of-Glory scoping is not enforced (fires on any self skill use). 'Most damaged ally' = lowest-HP allied hero (includes Ayana, matching this kit's 'ally'/'target ally' usage).

skill.name: Blessed Leylines
skill.note: The permanent '+5 healing received from all sources (does not stack)' is a real incoming_heal_mod (magnitude 5, duration null) that applyHeal adds to every heal the target receives, taking the MAX across instances so it does not stack. Invulnerable 1 turn is native.

passive.name: Panacea
passive.description: Every 3 turns, Ayana is cleansed of all enemy effects at the end of her turn.
passive.note: turnEnd fires for BOTH teams (no event-team predicate), so the 3-count spans both teams' turn-ends rather than only Ayana's turns. 'Cleansed of all enemy effects' = strip the enemy-applied harmful statuses (stun/silence/paralysis/blind/taunt/isolated/shatter/dot/incoming_damage_mod/heal_lock); there is no single cleanse-all-debuffs primitive and removeStatus cannot filter by applier.

skill.name: Healing Hands
skill.note: 'Activates Panacea' when used on Ayana = the same cleanse the passive performs (strip enemy-applied harmful statuses from self).

passive.name: Godly Wisdom
passive.description: Every 3 times enemies trigger Voice of Light or Prayer, Ayana automatically uses Voice of Glory.
passive.note: 'Enemies trigger Voice of Light' = a Voice-of-Light-marked enemy deals damage (eventSource has the 'Voice of Light' mark); 'trigger Prayer' = a Prayer-marked ally takes damage (eventTarget has the 'Prayer' mark). Each occurrence consumes its mark (one-shot, mirroring the base trigger) and adds a 'Godly Wisdom' stack; the 3rd resets the stack and useSkill ayana5 (Voice of Glory). Fusion replace-mode drops the base essence triggers, so these re-hook the same marks (still applied by base skills ayana1/ayana3).

skill.name: Verse of Ascension
skill.note: 'Ignores harmful effects for 2 turns' = damage_ignore (all damage) + non_damage_ignore (harmful non-damage) for 2. 'Activates Chorus' = useSkill ayana2. 'This skill cannot be stunned' = the Unstunnable tag, which isStunnedFor honors (the skill is castable even while Ayana is stunned).

passive.name: Searing Rebuke
passive.description: If an enemy triggers Voice of Light, they receive 15 Affliction damage.
passive.note: 'Triggers Voice of Light' = a 'Voice of Light'-marked enemy deals damage (eventSource has the mark). The mark is consumed so the rebuke fires once per Voice of Light application, mirroring the base trigger.

skill.name: Final Word
skill.note: Double damage when both Ayana and her target are alone: Ayana has 0 living hero allies AND the target's team has exactly 1 living hero (the target). Modelled as 25 -> 50 piercing.

passive.name: Illumination
passive.description: While Prism Sentence is active, all invisible skills become visible.
passive.note: Modeled as True Sight: the active grants Ayana's team a `reveal` status for the same 2-turn window as the Prism Sentence mark, so viewerHasReveal() is true and redactState stops hiding the opponent's Invisible effects from this team — every enemy invisible skill/effect becomes visible to Ayana's player while the window lasts.

skill.name: Prism Sentence
skill.note: Stun 2 turns is native. 'Receive double damage from Voice of Light' = a source-scoped incoming_damage_mult (x2, viaSourceId ayana1.hit) applied with the mark. 'Casting VoL on them also casts it on the enemy team, Bypassing' = base ayana1, when the target is Prism-marked, additionally forEaches enemies for a bypass:true VoL hit. The 'Prism Sentence' mark also drives Illumination's reveal.

effects.note: 'Receive double damage from Voice of Light': a source-scoped incoming_damage_mult (x2, viaSourceId ayana1.hit) so ONLY VoL hits on the marked enemy are doubled.

passive.name: Hallowed Footsteps
passive.description: When dealing damage to or healing a target affected by your Consecrate, deal 10 additional damage or healing to them. This effect is not triggered by Consecrate.
passive.note: 'Affected by your Consecrate' = has the named dot 'Consecrate' (enemies) or regen 'Consecrate' (allies) that the active applies. The 'Hallowed Proc Lock' mark is the house re-entrancy guard (set before the rider, removed after) so the +10 fires once per hit. Heal side: regen ticks do not emit healReceived, so 'not triggered by Consecrate' holds natively. Damage side: the Consecrate dot tick emits damageDealt (sourceId 'Consecrate'), and the trigger excludes it with {not:{eventSourceId:'Consecrate'}} -- so 'not triggered by Consecrate' holds on both sides.

skill.name: Consecrate
skill.note: 5 Piercing to all enemies for 5 turns = a named dot 'Consecrate' (mag 5, piercing, dur 5). 5 HP to all allies for 5 turns = a named regen 'Consecrate' (mag 5, dur 5). The shared name 'Consecrate' is what the Hallowed Footsteps passive reads as 'affected by your Consecrate'.

passive.name: Divine Ire
passive.description: Whenever an enemy deals damage to Ayana's allies, she permanently deals 5 additional damage to them with Voice of Light (stacks).
passive.note: Records the +5-per-occurrence Voice-of-Light bonus as a stacking 'Divine Ire' marker (magnitude +5) on the offending enemy (eventSource = 'them'). Base Voice of Light (ayana1) reads it: each enemy's VoL hit deals 15 + statusMag(Divine Ire of that enemy) — permanent, not consumed (both the Chorus forEach and single-target branches). statusMag is 0 for a non-Divine-Ire ayana. 'Allies' = Ayana's team heroes.

skill.name: Voice of Vengeance
skill.note: 35 + 5 per dead hero ally; becomes Piercing when both hero allies are dead (dead-ally count >= 2). Same amount expression in both branches.

passive.name: Word of the Law
passive.description: Triggering Voice of Light causes the target to take 10 additional damage from it for 2 turns.
passive.note: 'Triggering Voice of Light' = a 'Voice of Light'-marked enemy deals damage (eventSource has the mark); the mark is consumed (one-shot). 'Take 10 additional damage from it [Voice of Light] for 2 turns' is VoL-scoped; incoming_damage_mod (+10 for 2 turns) is the closest status but applies to ALL incoming damage, not Voice of Light only - tracked scope debt. The second trigger (source 'Bounty') realizes the Bounty active's lingering lifesteal, which statuses cannot host.

skill.name: Bounty
skill.note: Shatter target 2 turns is native. 'Allies who deal damage to them are healed 10 during this time' is a lingering reactive with no status host, so it is realized by the standing 'Bounty' trigger above, gated on this 2-turn 'Bounty' mark.

passive.name: Inquisition
passive.description: Triggering Voice of Light now Isolates the target for 1 turn.
passive.note: 'Triggering Voice of Light' = a 'Voice of Light'-marked enemy deals damage (eventSource has the mark); the mark is consumed (one-shot). 'Isolates the target' = the isolated status (cannot be targeted by new helpful skills) for 1 turn on that enemy.

skill.name: Purge the Wicked
skill.note: 'All units are Shattered' for 3 turns = shatter to faction 'all'. 'Immune to counters' = uncounterable. 'Immune to stuns' = the 'Stun Immunity' mark honoured by scheduler.isStunnedFor. All applied to both teams for 3 turns.

passive.name: Plaguebringer
passive.description: Enemies affected by the Black Knight's enhanced abilities take 5 Affliction damage each turn, permanently (stacks).
passive.note: 'Enhanced' = the Black Knight's acts-alone state (self mark 'Exile'); its maintainer trigger is now origin:'innate' so it SURVIVES replace-mode fusion, so the enhanced state is actually reachable post-fusion. 'Affected by' is faithful: reacts on skillUsed(eventSource==self) and forEaches eventAffected, applying/growing the dot on each affected enemy. 'Permanently (stacks)' = a duration-null affliction dot whose magnitude grows +5 each enhanced ability (modifyStatus). No re-entrancy: the dot tick emits damageDealt, not skillUsed.

skill.name: Fester
skill.note: 'Deals 20 damage to a target affected by Plaguebringer, and lowers their damage by 5, permanently (stacks).' 20 normal damage; the 'Bypassing' class is kept as a metadata tag but the damage is left normal (no glossary confirms what it bypasses — the standing convention). 'affected by Plaguebringer' is a targeting precondition, not re-checked in-effect. 'Lowers their damage by 5, permanently (stacks)' = a named outgoing_damage_mod that grows -5 per cast (modifyStatus), which by engine rule only reduces normal/piercing (non-Affliction) damage.

passive.name: Lonely Thirst
passive.description: The Black Knight heals 5 health whenever he damages an enemy, increased to 10 if his skills are enhanced.
passive.note: 'Enhanced' = self mark 'Exile' (acts-alone). Heal 5, or 10 while Exile is held. Fires on each self-sourced damageDealt against an enemy (including ticks of any dot he applied). Under default 'replace' fusion the base Exile maintainer is swapped out, so the enhanced (10) branch only fires if the enhanced state is otherwise present.

skill.name: Bloodsoaked Strike
skill.note: 'Deals 40 damage to target enemy. While enhanced, this skill deals 15 less damage, but its damage changes to Affliction and it becomes AOE.' Base = 40 normal to the single target. Enhanced (mark 'Exile') = 40-15 = 25 Affliction to the whole enemy team (AOE = {faction:'enemies'}).

passive.name: The Onyx Legion
passive.description: Allies affected by Curse of Fealty never count as acting when determining if The Black Knight is acting alone.
passive.note: This passive modifies the acts-alone determination, which the base kit maintains via the custom 'exileActingAlone' ledger (an engine gap: there is no selector/condition for 'acted this turn'). Because fusion replaces the base passive, this form must RE-INSTALL that maintainer so the Black Knight still becomes enhanced (mark 'Exile') and gains Elemental Essence when acting alone — but here allies holding the 'Curse of Fealty' mark are excluded from the acting count (excludeMark). Essence element is the fused element, 'curse'. Last-resort custom: identical rationale to the base kit's single custom node.

args.note: Re-installs the enhanced (acts-alone) maintainer removed by fusion: if the Black Knight is the sole acting ally this turn, apply/refresh self mark 'Exile' (1 turn) and grant self Elemental Essence (curse); otherwise remove 'Exile'. Allies holding the 'Curse of Fealty' mark do NOT count toward the acting total. Requires the acted-this-turn ledger (tracked engine gap, ENGINE_GAPS blackknight0).

passiveTriggers.note: LAST-RESORT custom: 'acting alone' cannot be read by any existing selector/condition (the acted-this-turn ledger is unbuilt), and this passive's whole content is the exclusion rule on that count. Re-installs the maintainer with excludeMark so the enhanced/essence mechanic survives fusion while honoring the Curse-of-Fealty carve-out.

skill.name: Curse of Fealty
skill.note: 'The Black Knight targets an enemy or one of his allies. For 3 turns, that unit deals 5 less non-Affliction damage and the Black Knight deals 5 more damage. If empowered, this skill affects another random valid target.' 'Non-Affliction' is automatic: outgoing_damage_mod only touches normal/piercing. The -5 debuff + a 'Curse of Fealty' mark (read by The Onyx Legion) go on the target; the Black Knight gains +5 (separately named so it is not cancelled by the -5). 'Empowered' = mark 'Exile'; when set, the debuff+mark are spread to one more random unit (bound once via forEach so both statuses hit the same pick). AMBIGUITIES: the extra target is not guaranteed distinct from the primary, and the Black Knight's +5 is applied once (not re-added per extra target).

passive.name: Hellfire
passive.description: The Black Knight's abilities permanently apply Hellfire to all enemy targets affected, dealing 5 affliction damage every turn. This effect does not stack
passive.note: Applies on ALL of his abilities (not enhanced-gated). 'Affected' approximated as 'damaged'. Hellfire = a duration-null affliction dot (5/turn). 'Does not stack' realized by the not-has guard: apply only if the enemy lacks Hellfire — which also prevents the Hellfire tick's self-sourced damageDealt from re-applying/refreshing it.

skill.name: Infernal Blow
skill.note: 'The Black Knight draws in the Hellfire from all targets, dealing 10 affliction damage to any target that had a stack. Then he deals 15 damage to one target, increased by 5 for every stack removed.' Since Hellfire does not stack, stacks-removed = the number of Hellfire-bearing enemies. The single-target hit (15 + 5*count) is ordered BEFORE the draw-in so it reads the pre-removal count; the draw-in then deals 10 Affliction and strips Hellfire from every holder. Reordering does not change the numbers.

passive.name: Merciless
passive.description: Oathbreaker Strike may now be used on allied Heroes. If the Black Knight kills an ally in this way, he deals 10 additional damage for the rest of the game.
passive.note: Clause 1 ('Oathbreaker Strike may now be used on allied Heroes') is a targeting-legality change to blackknight1 — there is no effect-op or trigger that expands a base skill's legal targets, so it is DOCUMENTED, not modeled. Clause 2 is the trigger below: on a unit's death whose killer is the Black Knight and whose faction is ally, grant +10 permanent damage. Since the only way he can damage an ally is that expanded Oathbreaker, killer=self + dead-ally is a faithful proxy for 'in this way' (the death event does not carry which skill killed). 'For the rest of the game' is modeled as duration null (round-permanent — the engine's longest status scope; true cross-round persistence is a known scope limitation). Single +10 (named, so it refreshes rather than double-stacking on a second ally kill — matching a one-time bonus per prose read).

skill.name: Horrify
skill.note: 'Deals 15 damage to a target and stuns them for 1 turn. While enhanced, the target is also Isolated for 1 turn.' 15 normal + a full 1-turn stun; enhanced (mark 'Exile') adds Isolated for 1 turn.

passive.name: Ethereal Form
passive.description: The turn after ignoring a skill, the Black Knight deals 10 additional damage.
passive.note: 'Ignoring a skill': the Black Knight's Dead or Alive (blackknight4) 'ignores all new Harmful skills for 1 turn', modeled as damage_ignore + non_damage_ignore. So a skill is 'ignored' exactly when it is Harmful, targets him (self in eventTargets), comes from an enemy (eventSource != self), AND the ignore window is active (he holds damage_ignore/non_damage_ignore). The skillUsed event carries the caster's skill tags (scheduler emits tags: skill.tags), so eventHasTag verifies Harmful directly. 'The turn after' = schedule delayTurns 1, applying a 1-turn +10 outgoing_damage_mod plus the 'Ethereal Form' mark that Ghostblade reads. Reacting on skillUsed (post-resolution) is observably identical to an in-resolution signal because the effect is deferred a full turn.

skill.name: Ghostblade
skill.note: 'Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If under the effect of Ethereal Form, this damage bypasses and becomes piercing.' 25 to the target; under the 'Ethereal Form' mark it becomes piercing (ignores Damage Reduction — matching the base kit's 'becomes piercing' convention). The extra 'bypass' (shield-ignore) beyond piercing is not separately expressible without switching to affliction/true typing, so piercing is used per precedent. The passive's +10 outgoing_damage_mod applies on top while Ethereal Form is active.

passive.name: Gravekeeper
passive.description: The Black Knight begins play with 3 Grave minions.
passive.note: 'Begins play with 3 Grave minions' = summon 3 'Grave' minions at round start. Fresh-battle rounds reset units, so each round begins with 3 Graves (the once-per-match vs per-round reading resolves to per-round given round resets). The 6-minion cap is enforced by the summon op.

skill.name: Bury
skill.note: 'Deals 25 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each living Zombie. If this kills an enemy, the Black Knight creates a Grave if he has space.' Damage = 25 + 10 per living 'Zombie' minion on the Black Knight's side. If the hit drops the target to 0 HP, summon a 'Grave'; 'if he has space' is handled by the 6-minion summon cap.

passive.name: Legion of the Damned
passive.description: When the Black Knight uses an enhanced ability, he summons two Skeleton minions. Maximum 4.
passive.note: 'Enhanced ability' = a self skill use while he holds mark 'Exile' (acts-alone). skillUsed carries no tags, but the enhanced gate captures 'enhanced'. Summons 2 'Skeleton' minions, capped at 4 via the count<4 gate (Skeleton counts stay even under +2 summons, so <4 caps exactly at 4). Under default 'replace' fusion the base Exile maintainer is swapped out, so this fires only while the enhanced state is present.

skill.name: Boneshape
skill.note: 'Sacrifices a Skeleton minion and gives the Black Knight 20 Shield.' Gated on having a Skeleton: defeat one 'Skeleton' minion (lowest-HP pick) and grant 20 permanent Shield. The sacrifice is the cost, so no Skeleton means no Shield.

passive.name: Unflinching Thrall
passive.description: While the Black Knight has a Reanimated ally, he gains 15 DR
passive.note: Aura with no aura primitive, so it is event-driven: grant the Black Knight 15 DR (damage_reduction) when an ally gains the 'Reanimated' mark (applied by Reanimate), and remove it when a Reanimated ally dies. CAVEATS: (a) statusApplied over-fires when an already-Reanimated ally receives any other status, but re-applying the same-named 15 DR is idempotent; (b) the DR is a single 15 regardless of how many Reanimated allies exist, and one Reanimated death clears it — acceptable since Reanimate's cost/cooldown makes multiple Reanimated allies unlikely.

skill.name: Reanimate
skill.note: 'Reanimates one dead ally, reviving them with 50 HP, and permanently stunning their Strategic skills.' Revive the (dead-ally) target at 50 HP; a permanent stun scoped to Strategic-tagged skills (mode 'only') locks their Strategic skills; the 'Reanimated' mark ties them to Unflinching Thrall's 15-DR aura. Target must be a dead ally (handled by the revive op).

passive.name: Hunger for Battle
passive.description: The Black Knight deals 5 additional damage whenever he deals damage. This effect stacks, but is removed if the Black Knight ends a turn without dealing damage.
passive.note: +5 outgoing damage each time he deals damage, stacking on a single named outgoing_damage_mod via magnitudeDelta. A 'Fed' mark records that he dealt damage; at turn end, if unfed the whole buff is stripped (decay), else the flag resets. LIMITATIONS: (1) turnEnd is not unit/team-scoped for a specific hero — it fires at BOTH teams' turn ends, so the decay check can fire on the opponent's turn end and prematurely wipe the buff (the standing turnEnd team-scoping gap; 'ends A turn' cannot be pinned to his own turn); (2) 'whenever he deals damage' is read per damage instance, so a multi-target hit adds one stack per unit hit.

skill.name: Fervor
skill.note: 'Deals 25 piercing damage to a target, and gives the Black Knight Elemental Essence.' 25 piercing to the target; grant self Elemental Essence (duration null).

passive.name: Rotten Vitality
passive.description: Seedling Minions return to the battlefield 1 turn after they die.
passive.note: When an allied minion dies, schedule a fresh Seedling to be summoned 1 of Gaia's turn-ends later. Template-scoping ('Seedling' specifically) is not enforceable in a Condition (no template predicate), so the trigger gates on isKind minion + isFaction ally and re-summons a Seedling; it over-fires for a dying Worldsprout. 'Return to the battlefield' is realized as a fresh summon (schedule+summon) rather than reviving the exact corpse.

passive.name: Roiling Life
passive.description: Enemies damaged by Worldfist take 10 damage on the following turn. This effect lasts one additional turn with each time Channel Earth has been used.
passive.note: Realized as a 'Roiling Life' dot (10, normal) applied to the struck enemy, duration = 1 + Gaia's Channel Earth stacks (each stack = one extra turn). The dot ticks at Gaia's (applier) turn-end, i.e. 'the following turn'. 'Damaged by Worldfist' is scoped via {eventSourceId:'gaia2'} (the damageDealt event's sourceId falls back to the casting skill id), so only Worldfist hits seed the dot — the fusion active Overgrowth's own hit no longer does. The named dot doubles as the 'Roiling Life' marker Overgrowth reads.

passive.name: Magnetic Shielding
passive.description: When Rampart's Shield takes damage, Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth.
passive.note: On shieldDamaged for Gaia's own Shield pool (sameUnit eventUnit self), add a permanent Channel Earth stack. The engine has one Shield pool per unit, so 'Rampart's Shield' is faithfully 'Gaia's Shield' (Rampart is her only shield source).

passive.name: Rising Indignation
passive.description: Whenever Gaia receives new damage, the cost of Gaia's Fury is reduced by [65], stacking. At 3 stacks, Gaia's Fury is automatically cast. During this time, Moonspike may not be used, and the Gaia's Fury minion deals and receives 10 additional damage.
passive.note: Each time Gaia takes damage (damageDealt with eventTarget self) she gains a Rising Indignation stack; at 3 stacks Gaia's Fury (gaiamoon1) auto-casts (useSkill) and the stack resets. The load-bearing outcome (auto-cast at 3) is realized. All three 'during this time' clauses are now expressed (Reading A: every Gaia's Fury minion is enraged): (a) the per-stack [65] discount = costMods:{mul(stackCount('Rising Indignation'),-1)} on gaiamoon1 (1 stack -> 2 generic, 2 -> 1, 3 -> 0+auto-cast); (b) 'Moonspike may not be used' = gaiafury2.requires:{not has 'Enraged'} on the minion (which carries the Enraged mark); (c) the minion's +10 dealt/received = intrinsic outgoing_damage_mod/incoming_damage_mod +10 in the 'Gaia's Fury' template's new statuses[].

passive.name: Branch of the World Tree
passive.description: Channel Vitality now costs [65] and affects all targets, but can only target minions.
passive.note: Re-authors base Channel Vitality (gaia3) via a roundStart mutableSkill patch (branchOfWorldTree, idempotent): cost 1-specific -> 1-generic, targeting single -> all-allies, targetKind -> minion (heals all allied minions, since Channel Vitality is Helpful). mutableSkill is the base-skill metadata patch channel.

passive.name: Oasis
passive.description: At the end of each turn, if Gaia or her allied Heroes did not have Elemental Essence, they gain Elemental Essence and heal 10 HP.
passive.note: On turnEnd, every allied hero (incl. Gaia) lacking Elemental Essence gains it and heals 10. turnEnd fires for BOTH teams, so 'each turn' also fires on the enemy's turn-end (a known event-team-scoping limitation); the effect only touches Gaia's own team either way.

skill.name: Sandstorm
skill.note: 'Deals 5 to the enemy team for 4 turns' = a 4-turn, magnitude-5 dot on each enemy. The two 'during this time' auras are installed by worldfistAuras: (1) 'Rampart costs [65]' = a 4-turn cost_currency_remap on gaia4 (moves its single [earth] onto generic, i.e. 1 generic = [65], any color pays; auto-reverts); (2) 'enemies damaged by Worldfist are Blinded 1 turn' = a 4-turn self-owned watch on Gaia's damageDealt vs enemies (the Sandstorm dot ticks carry source=Gaia, so they blind too).

passive.name: Sacred Grove
passive.description: Until they use a Harmful skill, the allied Heroes heal for 5 health per turn. If an ally under this effect is damaged, the attacker is marked by Sacred Grove.
passive.note: At round start each allied hero gets a permanent 'Sacred Grove' regen (5/turn, ticking at Gaia's turn-end); when an ally declares a Harmful skill (skillDeclared + eventHasTag Harmful) that ally's regen is removed. Separately, when an ally still holding the regen is damaged, the attacker (eventSource) is marked 'Sacred Grove' (the mark Expel Intruders consumes).

skill.name: Expel Intruders
skill.note: 'will not remove Sacred Grove from Gaia' is automatic: Gaia's buff is the 'Sacred Grove' regen (a different status kind); consuming the target's 'Sacred Grove' mark cannot touch it.

passive.name: Nutrient Sludge
passive.description: Whenever Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth, she heals all allied minions 5 HP. If they are at max HP, they gain 5 max HP.
passive.note: 'Gaia gains a Channel Earth stack' is proxied by 'an allied minion used a skill' (isKind minion + isFaction ally): the addStack effect emits no statusApplied event, and a Seedling's only skill (Channel Earth) is Gaia's canonical stack source, so a minion acting stands in for the stack gain (over-fires for a Worldsprout acting). Each allied minion at full HP grows +5 max HP (custom increaseMaxHp, which raises max and current), otherwise heals 5. The 'currentHp >= count-of-it' comparison is a count(it)==maxHp trick: count of a single-unit selector is 1, so this is really 'at full HP' -- see engine note; realized as currentHp>=maxHp via ref count of it giving the unit's own membership? Replaced below with a maxHp read.

skill.name: Life From the Loam
skill.note: Heals every allied unit (heroes + minions) 25. The 'whenever an allied unit dies, this skill costs 1 less for 1 turn' rider is a standing reactive, so it is installed as the second passive trigger (source 'Life From the Loam'): an ally death applies a 1-turn, skill-id-scoped -1 cost_mod on gaiaslime1 (scopedCostMod).

passive.name: Shroomtender
passive.description: Instead of Seedling minions, Gaia now begins play with one Mushroom minion.
passive.note: This form's passive REPLACES the base 'Yggdrasil's Bounty' (start with two Seedlings): at round start Gaia summons one Mushroom instead. 'Begins play' = start of each fresh-battle round -> a roundStart summon.

skill.name: Sow the Spores
skill.note: 10 affliction to the enemy team + 10 per Mushroom minion 'in the game' (count of Mushroom-template minions on either team, faction all).

passive.name: Nurturing Light
passive.description: At the end of her turn, all active Seedling minions gain 10 max HP.
passive.note: On turnEnd, every allied Seedling minion gains +10 max HP (custom increaseMaxHp raises max and current). turnEnd fires for both teams; the selector is Gaia's own Seedlings, so an enemy turn-end would also grow them (event-team-scoping limitation). Sunbeam later resets these Seedlings' max HP to default.

skill.name: Sunbeam
skill.note: Base 15 + 10 per full 20 HP summed across Gaia's Seedlings (floor(sum currentHp / 20)). 'Max HP returned to default' is realized by re-transforming each Seedling into the Seedling template (keepHp:true clamps current HP to the restored 25 max without a full heal).

passive.name: Forced Adaptation
passive.description: While Gommar is Frost-Covered, he ignores non-damage effects.
passive.note: 'While Frost-Covered' is a dynamic conditional; the engine has no continuous-conditional status primitive, so it is modeled as a gain/loss pair over the non_damage_ignore ward. The ward is armed EAGERLY on skillDeclared (which fires pre-resolution, before the declared skill's effects apply -- so even the FIRST enemy non-damage effect while Frost-Covered is warded), and also on any status applied to Gommar while Frost-Covered (mid-turn gains). It is stripped on any status expiring on him while he no longer holds Frost-Covered.

passive.name: Dazzling Lights
passive.description: The first enemy to use a skill on Gommar while he is Frost-Covered will have their skill costs increased by [65] for 1 turn.
passive.note: 'first enemy ... will' = fires once, gated by a round-permanent self mark 'Dazzling Lights' set on the first proc. 'use a skill on Gommar' = skillDeclared with declaredTargetsSelf from an enemy. '[65]' transcribed literally as cost_mod magnitude 65 (the bracket in the oracle is likely a percentage/placeholder).

effect.note: '[65]' is the generic-energy icon, so 'increased by [65]' = +1 generic cost (magnitude 1, matching Syl's 'cost 1 more [65]'), NOT 65. Duration 2 (not 1): the cost_mod is anchored to Gommar's team, so a duration-1 status ticks off at his next turn-end before the enemy's next turn; duration 2 keeps it live to tax the enemy's next skill ('for 1 turn').

effects.note: 'invulnerable to Strategic skills for 1 turn' -> scoped invulnerable {tag:Strategic, mode:only}, honored by legalTargets (blocks only Strategic harmful skills).
'The following turn, they are invulnerable to non-Strategic skills' = a scheduled (delay 1) invulnerable scoped to all-except-Strategic. Same tag-scope caveat as above.

passive.name: Frosted Facets
passive.description: Gommar takes half damage from new Harmful skills.
passive.note: The engine's damage mitigations (incoming_damage_mod, damage_reduction) are FLAT additive (see damage.ts), so a x0.5 multiplicative reduction on new Harmful-skill damage has no status primitive. Modeled as the single custom clause: a persistent half-damage multiplier on incoming new Harmful damage, installed at round start.

effect.note: 'takes half damage from new Harmful skills' — no flat status expresses a x0.5 multiplier; installs a persistent halving of incoming new Harmful-skill damage.

effects.note: Decomposed splash: 10 to the whole enemy team then +20 to the focal target below, yielding 30 to the target and 10 to each of the target's two allies (frozen targeting_type 'all' refined to a focal 'single' + splash so 'target' is addressable).

then.note: 'all damaged enemies' = the whole enemy team, since every enemy was damaged above.

passive.name: Glacial Advance
passive.description: At the start of each round, Gommar gains 5 Damage Reduction and is stunned for 2 turns. When this effect expires, he permanently ignores stun effects.
passive.note: 'gains 5 Damage Reduction' modeled as duration null (round-permanent). The 2-turn stun carries onExpire that grants permanent stun-immunity; there is no stun-scoped ignore, so non_damage_ignore (the umbrella covering stun, per aramao/other notes) is used and is marginally broader than the oracle's stun-only carve-out.

effects.note: Frozen targeting_type 'all' refined to 'all-enemies' per the oracle ('all enemies').

passive.name: Icy Blood
passive.description: Gommar ignores periodic Affliction damage.
passive.note: damage_ignore does not distinguish periodic (DoT ticks) from new Affliction hits, so this blanket Affliction damage_ignore is marginally broader than the oracle's 'periodic' scope. Installed at round start (round-permanent).

effects.note: 'ignores harmful non-damage effects' for his next 2 turns.
'When this skill ends [after his next 2 turns], Gommar dies.'

passive.name: Two Crowns
passive.description: At the start of each round, Gommar summons Bjorn, True King.
passive.note: The redirect trigger below is not in the passive prose; it is the mechanism that powers the King's Saddle active's 'redirects any damage Gommar would take to Bjorn' (mirrors Hector's Protect Me!/Dennis). It is inert until the active sets the 'King's Saddle' mark on Gommar and expresses damage-redirect via skill-declaration redirect (the only redirect primitive).

skill.name: King's Saddle
skill.note: 'Cannot be used if Bjorn, True King has been killed' -> requires a LIVING Bjorn (count of the allied Bjorn minion >= 1; faction selectors are alive-filtered). If Bjorn is dead/absent the skill is rejected.

effects.note: Arms the Two Crowns redirect trigger for 3 turns ('redirects any damage Gommar would take to Bjorn').

then.name: Frost-Covered
then.note: 'If Gommar consumes Frost-Covered' = the branch removes the mark.
'Bjorn, True King will cast Sovereign's Howl (mythminion1) on a random enemy.'

passive.name: Black Ice
passive.description: While Gommar is Frost-Covered, he is Stealthed.
passive.note: 'While Frost-Covered' modeled as a gain/loss pair (no continuous-conditional primitive, no event-status-kind condition): on any status applied to Gommar while he holds Frost-Covered, grant stealth (permanent); on any status expiring on him while he no longer holds Frost-Covered, strip it.

skill.name: Midnight Mountain
skill.note: 'If Gommar is Stealthed, this skill Bypasses' = bypassingIf {has stealth of caster}: at declaration the skill is treated as Bypassing (ignores Invulnerability when targeting; its damage ignores DR+Shield) exactly while Gommar holds the Stealth status (Black Ice grants it while Frost-Covered).

then.note: 'lowers the target's damage by 10 for 3 turns'.

passive.name: Snowy Glare
passive.description: Whenever Gommar gains Frost-Covered, enemies with lowered damage are Blinded for 1 turn.
passive.note: 'gains Frost-Covered' detected via statusApplied on self while Frost-Covered is present (no event-status-kind condition), so it over-fires when he gains any other status while already Frost-Covered. 'enemies with lowered damage' = enemies carrying an outgoing_damage_mod (matches the base Frost-Covered passive's 'reduced damage' convention).

effects.note: 'healing them for 5 HP per turn' for 2 turns = regen.

then.note: 'deals 10 piercing damage to the enemy team for 2 turns' = an immediate pulse now plus one scheduled pulse next turn (mirrors Maggie's 'for 2 turns' modeling).

passive.name: Natural Cryogenics
passive.description: While Frost-Covered, Gommar heals for 15 health per turn if he takes no action.
passive.note: 'if he takes no action' tracked via a duration-0 'Acted' mark stamped on Gommar's own skill use (clears at his turn end); the heal fires at turnEnd when Frost-Covered is present and no 'Acted' mark is set. turnEnd fires for BOTH teams and no condition reads event-team, so this over-fires on enemy turn-ends (known event-scoping gap).

effects.note: 'permanently stunned until Gommar loses Frost-Covered': the custom stuns the new Frozen Beast (dur null) AND arms a round-permanent one-shot watch that removes that stun on statusLost(mark 'Frost-Covered') of Gommar (self) — emitted by the removeStatus op when one of his actives consumes the charge. One-way release.

passive.name: Hypothermia
passive.description: When Gommar deals new damage to an enemy, he increases the damage they receive from all sources by 5 for 2 turns. This effect does not stack.
passive.note: 'increases damage they receive from all sources by 5' = incoming_damage_mod +5. 'does not stack' handled by a named 'Hypothermia' marker refreshed (remove-by-name then re-apply). 'new damage' (isNew) has no condition primitive; gated on Gommar as the damage source and an enemy target.

skill.name: Howling Gale
skill.note: 'If the target was already affected by Hypothermia' = the target carrying the 'Hypothermia' incoming_damage_mod. The Hypothermia passive fires synchronously on this skill's own damageDealt, so the 'already affected' test MUST be evaluated BEFORE the 35 damage lands -- otherwise the skill would stun a fresh target off its own freshly-applied Hypothermia. So the if-Hypothermia wraps the damage: both branches deal 35, the stun rides only the branch where the target was ALREADY affected.

passive.name: Cure-All
passive.description: Hector's Serums may now target any of his allies, and they remove one harmful effect on application and expiration.
passive.note: First clause ('Serums may now target any ally') is a targeting-rule change on the base Serum skills (hector1-3), not a reactive trigger. Second clause modeled reactively: on Serum application/expiration, cleanse one harmful effect from the affected ally. The condition vocabulary has no status-name matcher for statusApplied, so the trigger cannot verify the applied status is a Serum (Burning Blood/Stoneseal/Mindfog Serum); and statusExpired carries no unit field, so the expiration branch cannot bind the affected ally - the intended vehicle is each Serum's own onExpire cleanse.

effect.note: CUSTOM: removes one harmful effect of any kind; no primitive removeStatus can target 'one harmful of any kind'. Should be gated to fire only when the applied status is a Serum.

CUSTOM: on a Serum's expiration, remove one harmful effect from its bearer. statusExpired carries no unit and no name, so neither the Serum gating nor the affected-ally binding is expressible here; intended as the Serum status's own onExpire cleanse.

effects.note: CUSTOM: 'cleansed of all enemy effects' - remove every enemy-applied (harmful) status from the target ally; no primitive expresses a full enemy-effect cleanse.

Closest primitive for 'cannot be affected by those effects for the rest of the game' - permanent immunity to harmful non-damage effects; it does not restrict the immunity to exactly the effects just cleansed.

passive.name: Got a Job To Do
passive.description: Hector's Serums can now only be used on enemies. Being affected by a Serum also causes the target to receive 5 affliction damage for 3 turns.
passive.note: First clause ('Serums can now only be used on enemies') is a targeting-rule change on the base Serum skills, not a reactive trigger. Second clause modeled as a statusApplied trigger applying a 5/turn Affliction dot for 3 turns. The condition vocabulary has no status-name matcher, so the trigger cannot confirm the applied status is a Serum; it is gated with 'not has the Got a Job To Do dot' only to stop it re-firing on its own dot application.

effects.note: The mark's onExpire is the 'if this skill ends without being triggered' branch: Hector and the enemy team heal 15 HP.
'The target of this skill is invisible' - modeled as veiled (details hidden) on the target for the 2-turn window.

Implemented by armSkillUseTrap: marks the target 'Skill Trap' for 2 turns; if the target uses a skill, the onUse payload fires (15 Affliction + stun 1) and `cancels` removes the 'To Your Health!' mark, so its onExpire heal never fires.

passive.name: Borrowed Time
passive.description: Applies a random Serum to Dennis that he isn't already affected by whenever Hector gains energy from Elemental Essence.
passive.note: 'Gains energy from Elemental Essence' fires on the energyFromEssence event — emitted at the exact income moment an essence charge is converted to specific energy — scoped to Hector via sameUnit[eventUnit, self].

effect.note: CUSTOM: applies one random Serum (Burning Blood/Stoneseal/Mindfog) that Dennis is not already affected by, by re-running the real serum skill's effect on him.

passive.name: Apprenticeborn Pathogen
passive.description: Enemies damaged by Dennis receive Apprenticeborn Pathogen. This deals 5 damage the turn it is applied, lowers the target's damage by 10 for 1 turn the following turn, and then stuns the target on the final turn. Cannot be applied to enemies affected by Mutated Strain or Apprenticeborn Pathogen.
passive.note: The three-turn Pathogen is a mark plus two scheduled stages. schedule fires after the caster's (Hector's) turn-ends elapse, so 'the following turn' / 'the final turn' are approximated relative to Hector rather than the enemy. The mark gates re-application (cannot stack onto Apprenticeborn Pathogen or Mutated Strain).

then.note: Pathogen's stages run in reverse order, so the stun (last in Apprenticeborn Pathogen) is applied first.
Damage-reduction stage, twice as strong (-10 becomes -20).
Damage stage, five times as strong (5 becomes 25), now last due to reversed order.

passive.name: Dennisyphus
passive.description: All of Hector's [14] costs change to [65], but he no longer generates an Energy each turn. Dennis the Apprentice will use Lumbering Smash on a random enemy every turn.
passive.note: '[14] costs change to [65]' is a cost-channel remap (Generic energy glyph -> the element glyph) on Hector's whole kit - a cost-composition rule change with no reactive-trigger or status representation. 'No longer generates an Energy each turn' is modeled as a permanent silence (suppresses his Elemental Essence income), the closest primitive. Dennis's per-turn Lumbering Smash uses turnStart, which fires for both teams, so 'every turn' is not strictly Hector's-turn scoped.

effect.note: 'He no longer generates an Energy each turn' = income_suppressed: grantIncome yields Hector NOTHING (not even the fallback 1 Generic). (Silence only redirects essence->generic, so it still granted 1 Generic.)

effects.note: 'At the beginning of Hector's next turn, he gains 1 Generic Energy' - schedule fires after one of Hector's turn-ends.

passive.name: Perfect Form
passive.description: Hector consumes Dennis at the beginning of the round, gaining 50 Shield and 3 Elemental Essence. Hector's Serums now only target himself, and last 2 turns instead of 3.
passive.note: Base passive (which summons Dennis) is replaced by this fusion passive, so the consumed Dennis is one carried in from a prior state; 'consumes Dennis' is modeled as defeat on the allied Dennis minion. '3 Elemental Essence' is three elemental_essence charges (essence is a one-shot charge status). 'Serums now only target himself, last 2 turns' is a targeting/duration rule change on the base Serum skills, not a reactive trigger.

effect.note: 'Consumes Dennis' - outright removes the allied Dennis minion.

effects.note: Burning Blood Serum -> 5 extra damage and becomes Piercing (20 normal becomes 25 piercing). Detected via the Burning Blood Serum stack the base injection lays.

passive.name: A Dash of Whimsy
passive.description: Hector will use a random serum on the first character to use a skill on him each turn
passive.note: Trigger fires when a skill is used on Hector (sameUnit of eventTargets and self); 'the first character each turn' (once-per-turn) is not expressible and the random-serum selection needs a custom handler. skillUsed carries all targets in eventTargets, so the self-target check is the closest available gate.

effect.note: CUSTOM: Hector uses one random Serum on the character who used a skill on him. No primitive selects a random serum, and 'first character each turn' requires per-turn once-only bookkeeping.

then.note: '[65]' is one specific-element energy glyph, modeled as cost_mod -1. cost_mod has no tag scope, so 'their helpful skills only' cannot be restricted.
Implemented by armSkillUseReward: marks the ally 'Skill Reward' for 1 turn; if they use a skill within the window they gain Elemental Essence.

else.note: '[65]' modeled as cost_mod +1; cost_mod has no tag scope, so 'their Harmful skills only' cannot be restricted.

onExpire stun is the 'if they do not use a new skill they are stunned' branch; the 'unless they use a skill' cancellation is the removeMarkOnSkillUse custom below, which strips the 'A Sprinkle of Recklessness' mark if the enemy uses a skill (so its onExpire stun never fires).

passive.name: Try the Supply
passive.description: Applies any Serums Hector uses to himself as well.
passive.note: Trigger fires when Hector uses a skill (sameUnit of eventSource and self). skillUsed exposes no skillId/serum matcher in the condition vocabulary, so a custom handler must identify which Serum (Burning Blood/Stoneseal/Mindfog) was used and mirror it onto Hector.

effect.note: CUSTOM: re-applies whichever Serum Hector just used to himself; no condition matches the used skillId, so a custom handler inspects the used skill.

effects.note: 'During this time he ignores non-damage effects' - 3-turn non_damage_ignore.

CUSTOM: each turn for 3 turns, deal 5 Affliction to all enemies for each Serum on Hector. No primitive counts 'serums' (three distinct named statuses) or re-evaluates a scaling AoE per turn; dot is per-unit and fixes magnitude at apply time.

passive.name: Lingering Spores
passive.description: Whenever a Serum effect ends, a stack of Lingering Spores is placed on Dennis and a random enemy, dealing 5 affliction damage per turn if they are an enemy, and 5 healing per turn if they are an ally. This effect stacks.
passive.note: 'A Serum effect ends' = a status whose name contains 'Serum' expires (statusExpired carries the name). Hector's Serum skills apply their effects under names like 'Burning Blood Serum' / 'Stoneseal Serum' / 'Mindfog Serum' / 'Rejuvenation Serum', so {eventStatusNameIncludes:'Serum'} matches exactly those and is future-proof to new Serums. RULING: each Serum-named status expiry places one Lingering Spore, so a Serum applying two sub-statuses contributes once per sub-status as they lapse. Lingering Spores is modeled as a stacking status whose per-turn magnitude scales with its stack count (5 x stacks), delivered as regen on the ally Dennis and a dot on a random enemy.

effect.note: Ally (Dennis) branch: 5 healing per turn per stack.
forEach resolves the random enemy once so the stack and the dot land on the same target: 5 Affliction per turn per stack.

effects.note: delayTurns is a fixed number, so the dynamic countdown is modeled as a mark whose duration is a Value (3 minus Lingering Spores stacks on the target, floored at 0); its onExpire deals the 40 Affliction to the bearer.

passive.name: Rejuvenation Serum
passive.description: Any time an allied Hero becomes invulnerable, they heal 5 health for 3 turns.
passive.note: statusApplied has no kind matcher in the condition vocabulary, so 'becomes invulnerable' is gated on the post-event state (the affected ally hero currently has invulnerable); it can therefore fire on any status applied to an already-invulnerable ally hero rather than strictly when invulnerable is applied.

then.name: Rejuvenation Serum
then.note: Refresh to maximum (3): durationDelta = 3 minus remaining, mirroring the base Serum Overload refresh idiom.

passive.name: Drunken Swordsman
passive.description: Jarrik will deal 10 piercing damage to any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him. At the end of each turn, Jarrik will deal 10 piercing damage to a random enemy.

passiveTriggers.note: 'any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him' — fires on skillUsed when an enemy's skill targets Jarrik. skillUsed carries no class tags, so the Harmful-only qualifier can't be gated (in practice only Harmful skills target an enemy). A skillDeclared react would read tags but performAction never emits skillDeclared to the react bus, so skillUsed is the live hook.
'At the end of each turn' fires on every turn-end (both teams); turnEnd cannot be scoped to only Jarrik's turns.

effects.note: '5 more non-Affliction damage for 4 turns' = a named outgoing_damage_mod (engine sums it only for normal/piercing = 'non-Affliction'). Target may be Jarrik or an ally (single Helpful). 'Ends if they use a new skill' = the Drunken Swordsman skillUsed cancel trigger below; when Jarrik buffs HIMSELF a one-shot 'Cindersprig Grace' mark spares the very cast that applied it (his next skill still ends it).

passive.name: Final Breath
passive.description: The first time Jarrik dies, he instead becomes Immortal for one turn.
passive.note: 'The first time Jarrik dies, he instead becomes Immortal for one turn' is reconstructed as a unitDied react: on his first death, revive to 1 HP + Immortal(1), gated by a one-time 'Final Breath' mark. Round-start clears statuses, so the once-scope is per round rather than per match.

effects.note: 'damage equal to his missing HP' = missingHp of caster.

passive.name: Scorched Flesh
passive.description: Enemies affected by Cinders have the cost of their Strategic skills increased by [65].
passive.note: cost_mod is a flat, non-tag-scoped per-unit delta, so a faithful 'Strategic-only, follows the live Cinders set' aura needs native maintenance — re-evaluated each turn-start via a custom handler. [65] = one generic energy.

effect.note: Applies/removes a +1-generic Strategic-scoped cost increase across Cinders-marked enemies; re-run each turn-start so it tracks marks appearing/leaving. No pure-data expression (cost_mod lacks tag scope and dynamic membership).

effects.note: Arms a one-shot rider on the next Blade of Ashes (jarrik1): the mark drives jarrik1's uncounterableIf and its consume branch (Cinderling + clear).
'Triple damage': +20 to each base-10 Blade of Ashes hit (10 -> 30). Cleared by jarrik1's consume branch, so it lasts exactly one Blade of Ashes.

passive.name: Belphegor's Blade
passive.description: Each turn that Jarrik or an enemy affected by Cinders doesn't use a new skill, they receive 15 Affliction damage.
passive.note: 'Didn't use a new skill' reads the acted-this-turn ledger (state.actedThisTurn), which no Condition exposes — hence a native handler at turn-end.

effect.note: At each turn-end, deals 15 Affliction to Jarrik and to every Cinders-marked enemy who is NOT in state.actedThisTurn (did not use a new skill this turn).

effects.note: 'target's skills cost 1 more, increasing by 1 each turn; each new skill they use lowers the current magnitude by 1.' A named cost_mod +1 for 3 turns, escalated +1 each turn-end and decayed -1 on the holder's skillUsed (floored at 0), both via the Belphegor's Blade passiveTriggers below.

passive.name: Drake Transformation
passive.description: At the end of each turn and whenever he consumes a mark from Cinders, Jarrik heals 5 HP and permanently deals 5 more Affliction damage.
passive.note: Two fidelity gaps: (1) outgoing_damage_mod boosts only normal/piercing, not Affliction, so the +5 does not reach his Affliction hits; (2) 'whenever he consumes a Cinders mark' has no event — mark consumption (removeStatus) is silent — so only the per-turn half is modelled.

passiveTriggers.note: Seeds the permanent AFFLICTION damage bonus at 0 (dtypes:['affliction'] per 'deals 5 more Affliction damage') so turn-end growth has a status to modify (and resets the per-round accumulation).
Heals 5 and grows the permanent bonus by 5 each turn-end (both teams).

'and whenever he consumes a mark from Cinders, Jarrik heals 5 HP and permanently deals 5 more Affliction damage.' Cinders removal is Jarrik-exclusive and emits statusLost (natural lapse emits statusExpired instead), so the mark-name gate faithfully means 'Jarrik consumed a Cinders'. Mirrors the turnEnd effect (same clone as the Blazer Board consume trigger).

effects.note: 'After using this skill, Jarrik can no longer apply, trigger, or consume Cinders' — a permanent self-mark the base kit reads at all three sites: APPLY is suppressed at the interpreter chokepoint (a Drakken-holder's Cinders applyStatus is skipped), TRIGGER is gated in the jarrik0 Cinders passive ({not has mark Drakken}), and CONSUME is gated in jarrik3 Call Cinders ({not has mark Drakken}).

passive.name: Pursuit of Justice
passive.description: Jarrik can no longer be stunned or countered.
passive.note: 'Can no longer be stunned' = a permanent 'Stun Immunity' mark honoured by isStunnedFor; 'or countered' = permanent uncounterable. Re-applied each round start (statuses reset per round). The second trigger is the Execution Sentence watcher the active depends on (sourced to that skill), installed standing so the countdown/kill can run.

passiveTriggers.note: Realises the active's 'each time they use a skill, one stack is removed; at 0 stacks they are instantly killed'. Inert until Execution Sentence stacks exist on an enemy; each marked enemy is tracked independently.

effects.name: Execution Sentence
effects.note: Applies 5 Execution Sentence stacks; the decrement-per-skill-use and kill-at-zero are handled by the standing 'Execution Sentence' passive trigger.

passive.name: Blazer Board
passive.description: Whenever Jarrik consumes a mark from Cinders, he becomes Invulnerable until the end of his next turn. This effect is automatically activated at the start of each round.
passive.note: Two triggers: the round-start auto-activation, and the general 'whenever Jarrik consumes a Cinders mark' -> Invulnerable, now realised via statusLost (the removeStatus op emits it). Cinders removal is Jarrik-exclusive (natural lapse emits statusExpired, not statusLost), so the {mark 'Cinders'} gate faithfully means 'Jarrik consumed a Cinders'. Duration 1 approximates 'until the end of his next turn'.

skill.name: Pop Off
skill.note: 'only usable the turn after activating Blazer Board' — gated on Jarrik carrying the Invulnerable that Blazer Board grants, the closest available signal that it was activated (temporal 'turn after' not precisely representable).

then.note: Consuming a Cinders mark via Pop Off fires Blazer Board's Invulnerable directly (the one consume path this active controls).

passive.name: Blue Flame Spirits
passive.description: Cinderling minions are replaced by Azure Sparkling minions.
passive.note: Jarrik holds a permanent 'Blue Flame Spirits' mark (re-applied at round start); summonMinion reads it and mints Azure Sparkling in place of every Cinderling the base kit would summon (any path), so no per-skill patching is needed.

effects.note: '5 Piercing and Cinders to up to 3 different, random enemies' — random pick of 3 yields up to 3 distinct enemies (fewer if fewer alive).

passive.name: Ritual of the Reaper
passive.description: When Jarrik takes or deals damage, he gains that much Ritual Power, up to a maximum of 120.
passive.note: No Value reads the triggering event's damage amount, so a native handler accrues 'that much' Ritual Power and caps the stack at 120. The trigger fires when Jarrik is the dealer (deals) or the target (takes).

effect.note: Adds the event's hpLost amount to the 'Ritual Power' stack on Jarrik, capped at 120.

effects.note: 'Can only be used with >=60 Ritual Power' = requires gate; 'at 120 Ritual Power, strikes twice' = a second 25 Piercing when the stack is >=120. Prose does not say the power is consumed, so it is not spent.

passive.name: Dusken Ascendant
passive.description: Jarrik is permanently Blinded and creates one Cinder minion at the end of each turn.

passiveTriggers.note: 'creates one Cinder minion at the end of each turn' — summons a Cinderling (Jarrik's cinder minion). Fires on every turn-end (both teams); turnEnd can't be scoped to only Jarrik's turns.

effects.note: 'For 3 turns, all enemies are treated as affected by Cinders' = a 3-turn Cinders mark on every enemy; the base kit's name-keyed Cinders readers all count it.

'This effect cannot be consumed to create Cinderling minions': a companion marker. Call Cinders (jarrik3) still damages these enemies as Cinders-marked, but skips the mark-removal + Cinderling summon for any enemy also bearing 'Dawnbreak Cinders'.

passive.name: All Is Lost
passive.description: Whenever an allied hero dies, Keeper of Fables increases the Shield on Tales to Tell by 35.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Whenever an allied hero dies' -> add 35 Shield to Tales to Tell (Keeper's real Shield pool). Gated to allied heroes other than Keeper, matching the reference reading of 'an allied hero dies' (a dead Keeper cannot bank Shield).

skill.name: Tale of a Ruined World
skill.note: 'attempts to consume 40 Shield ... if he does' = guard ref:shield>=40 then custom consumeShield, then the payoff. 'lowers their damage by 5 for 2 turns' = outgoing_damage_mod magnitude -5 on the enemy team.

then.note: spend 40 Shield from Tales to Tell.

passive.name: Stellar Story
passive.description: Whenever Keeper successfully consumes Shield from Tales to Tell, he gains Elemental Essence.
passive.note: Keyed on the shieldConsumed event (emitted by the consumeShield custom only when real Shield and/or Chronicle Fragments were actually spent), so Essence is granted exactly on a SUCCESSFUL consume -- not on a guard-failed Page-turner or a Shield-ADDING skill.

skill.name: Colorful Characters
skill.note: Add Shield to Tales to Tell scaled by how many OTHER allies acted this turn: 20 base, 30 if one acted, 45 if both acted. No selector or Value exposes 'acted this turn', so a custom reads state.actedThisTurn (allied heroes excluding Keeper) and grants the tiered Shield via grantShield(duration:null). 'acts this turn' resolves to allies who have already acted at cast time.

effects.note: grantShield 20 / 30 / 45 to Tales to Tell for 0 / 1 / 2 other allied heroes having acted this turn.

passive.name: Chronicle Fragments
passive.description: Whenever the Shield from Tales to Tell is broken by damage, Keeper of Fables receives a stack of Chronicle Fragments. These Fragments are consumed by his abilities, counting as 10 Shield each.
passive.note: Second sentence ('Fragments are consumed by his abilities, counting as 10 Shield each') is now modeled: Keeper's Shield-cost checks read spendableShield (= totalShield + 10*stackCount('Chronicle Fragments')), and consumeShield spends real Shield first, then whole Fragments for the shortfall. Non-Keeper callers hold 0 Fragments, so both are backward-compatible.

passiveTriggers.note: shieldBroken carries unit=whose shield broke (eventUnit); gate on it being Keeper's own Tales to Tell pool, then gain one Chronicle Fragments stack.

skill.name: The World Mirror
skill.note: Adds 60 Shield to Tales to Tell and consumes all Chronicle Fragments stacks. 'Costs 1 less generic per Chronicle Fragments stack' is a costMods entry of -stackCount('Chronicle Fragments') on generic, evaluated at cast time BEFORE the effects consume the stacks (effectiveCost runs before pay/effects). The Shield grant and stack consumption are authored below.

effects.name: Chronicle Fragments
effects.note: 'all stacks consumed on use' -> clear the Chronicle Fragments stacks.

passive.name: Glacial Pacing
passive.description: Keeper of Fables begins the game with his skill costs increased by [65] [65]. Each turn for 2 turns, his skills will cost one less [65] permanently and Tales to Tell will gain 25 Shield.
passive.note: [65] = the generic-energy icon. Modeled as a standing cost_mod on all of Keeper's skills, +2 at start, decremented by 1 on each of the first two turns while granting 25 Shield. 'Permanently' is round-scoped: statuses reset at round start, so the whole ramp is re-derived each round via the roundStart trigger, consistent with the engine's round model.

effect.note: 'begins the game with skill costs increased by 2 generic' -- roundStart is the closest event to game start and re-establishes the +2 each round.

passiveTriggers.note: Two scheduled ticks lower the standing cost_mod (2 -> 1 -> 0 across turns 1-2) and add 25 Shield each. delayTurns counts game turns, not strictly Keeper's own turns (schedule has no team scope) -- a minor timing caveat noted per the engine's turn-scoping limitation.

Companion standing trigger armed by Iced Shelf (keeperglacier1). 'permanently stunned until a Helpful or Harmful skill is used on one of them; when ended for one, it ends for all.' Fires when a Helpful/Harmful skill is DECLARED onto any Iced Shelf bearer (skillDeclared carries the declared skill's tags, read by eventHasTag), then clears the stun AND the link mark from every bearer on both teams. Inert until the active applies the marks; lives here because the fusion's only trigger home is passiveTriggers (cf. base keeper's Chronicle Deeds).

skill.name: Iced Shelf
skill.note: Keeper and target enemy both become permanently stunned (duration null) and both carry the 'Iced Shelf' link mark. The Iced Shelf hero trigger (in passiveTriggers) ends the stun for ALL bearers the moment a Helpful or Harmful skill is used on any one of them.

passive.name: Licherature
passive.description: Keeper of Fables may no longer receive healing from any source. Tales to Tell now grants 10 additional Shield whenever it activates.
passive.note: First clause = permanent heal_lock (re-established each round; statuses are round-scoped). Second clause ('Tales to Tell grants 10 additional Shield whenever it activates') = a permanent shield_grant_bonus:10 on Keeper (re-applied each round), which addShield adds to every Shield grant he receives. The engine models Keeper's Shield as one pool, so all his grants count as Tales to Tell; a rare ally-sourced grant is also boosted, accepted under that one-pool model (shields aren't source-tagged, same limitation as keeper4's absorb cap).

passiveTriggers.note: 'may no longer receive healing from any source' = permanent self heal_lock, re-applied at each round start. 'Tales to Tell grants 10 additional Shield whenever it activates' = a permanent shield_grant_bonus:10 on Keeper (all his Shield lands in the one pool), which addShield adds to every grant.

skill.name: Tale from Beyond
skill.note: 'attempts to consume 25 Shield ... if successful' = guard ref:shield>=25 then consumeShield, then 30 Piercing to target increased by 10 per dead ally. 'each dead ally' = dead allied heroes (Keeper is alive casting), counted via ref:count over {faction:allies,kind:hero,alive:false}.

then.note: spend 25 Shield from Tales to Tell.

passive.name: Wise Old Man
passive.description: The Shield from Tales to Tell no longer prevents damage to Keeper of Fables. When Keeper of Fables dies, his allies gain Shield equal to the Shield on Tales to Tell, divided evenly and rounded up to the nearest increment of 5.
passive.note: First clause ('Shield no longer prevents damage to Keeper') = a permanent shield_non_absorbing on Keeper (re-applied each round): applyDamage skips his Shield absorption so damage falls through to HP, while the pool stays intact as a resource (consumeShield still spends it; the on-death read below still sees it). Second clause is the on-death distribution below.

effect.note: On Keeper's death, split the Shield remaining on Tales to Tell evenly among living allied heroes, each share rounded UP to the nearest 5, granted as Shield (duration null). No Value expresses 'divide a read Shield amount by ally count' or 'ceil(x/5)*5', so a custom computes and grants it.

passiveTriggers.note: Second clause of Wise Old Man: distribute Keeper's remaining Tales to Tell Shield to his allies when he dies.

Companion to Mentorship (keepermyth1): 'gain Essence if they deal damage' -- the mentored target (eventSource of the damage) gains Essence once, gated by the 'Mentorship: dealt' done-flag (applied first so its statusApplied echo cannot re-fire this trigger).
Companion to Mentorship: 'gain Essence if they are dealt damage' -- the mentored target (eventTarget/victim) gains Essence once.

Companion to Mentorship: 'gain Essence if they are stunned' -- once; discriminated by the mentored target now carrying a stun status (statusApplied unit = eventUnit). Done-flag applied before the essence to stop the statusApplied echo re-entering this trigger.
Companion to Mentorship: 'gain Essence if they become invulnerable' -- once; discriminated by the mentored target now carrying an invulnerable status.

skill.name: Mentorship
skill.note: For 3 turns target ally gains +5 damage (outgoing_damage_mod) and 5 Damage Reduction, plus a 3-turn 'Mentorship' window mark. The four companion Mentorship triggers (in passiveTriggers) each grant the target Elemental Essence once when it deals damage, is dealt damage, is stunned, or becomes invulnerable, using per-condition 'done' flags for the once-only limit.

effects.note: '5 increased damage' for 3 turns.
'5 Damage Reduction' for 3 turns.
3-turn window the Mentorship hero triggers read.

passive.name: Reading in the Dark
passive.description: Whenever an invisible skill is used, Keeper of Fables adds 10 Shield to Tales to Tell.
passive.note: Reads the unified invisibility flag: the eventHidden condition is true for ANY Invisible skill use — an inherently isHidden skill OR one cast from a cloak (veiled / Endless Night). So this fires for every invisible skill, not just Keeper's own Endless Night window (which is now a `cloak` status).

passiveTriggers.note: Fires whenever an Invisible skill is used (eventHidden) -> add 10 Shield to Tales to Tell.

skill.name: Tale of Endless Night
skill.note: For 2 turns the allied team's skills are Invisible. Modeled as a `cloak` status (a non-breaking concealment window) on each ally including Keeper: while cloaked, isConcealed() makes their skill-uses read as Invisible (redactState hides their effects; the hidden event flag drives Reading in the Dark) — and unlike veiled, a Harmful action does not strip it, so the whole 2-turn window stays Invisible.

passive.name: Blinding Reveal
passive.description: If Tales to Tell is broken by damage, the attacker is Blinded for 2 turns.

passiveTriggers.note: shieldBroken carries unit=whose shield broke (eventUnit) and source=the attacker (eventSource). When Keeper's own Tales to Tell breaks, Blind the attacker for 2 turns.

skill.name: Tale of the Coming Dawn
skill.note: 'attempts to consume 40 Shield ... if successful' = guard ref:shield>=40 then consumeShield, then heal all allies 25. 'all allies' read as the whole allied team including Keeper.

then.note: spend 40 Shield from Tales to Tell.

passive.name: Modernization
passive.description: While Keeper of Fables has Shield remaining on Tales to Tell, he ignores indirect from all sources.
passive.note: 'Indirect' is modeled as affliction damage (the game's indirect / damage-over-time type). There is no continuously-conditional status, so the immunity is established at round start when Shield is present and dropped when the Shield breaks; a break-then-regain within a round will not re-arm it (no shieldGranted event) -- a known fidelity gap.

passiveTriggers.note: While Tales to Tell holds Shield at round start, ignore indirect (affliction) damage from all sources.
Tales to Tell ran out (shield broken) -> drop the indirect-damage immunity.

skill.name: Tale of a Distant Future
skill.note: 'attempts to consume 35 Shield ... if successful' = guard ref:shield>=35 then consumeShield, then a permanent 5-Affliction DoT on every character. 'every character' = all units on both teams (faction:all, includes Keeper). 'This effect stacks' = each cast lays another DoT instance.

then.note: spend 35 Shield from Tales to Tell.

'deals 5 Affliction to every character for the rest of the game' = permanent (duration null) 5-Affliction DoT; round-scoped in practice. 'This effect stacks' -> stacks:true (a repeated cast accumulates +5/turn instead of refreshing).

passive.name: Crackling Hearth
passive.description: Whenever Shield is added to Tales to Tell, Keeper of Fables heals a random allied hero for 10 health.
passive.note: Keyed on the shieldGranted event (emitted by the grantShield op): when Shield is added to Keeper (Tales to Tell is his Shield pool), heal a random allied hero (excluding Keeper) 10.

when.name: A Tale of Joy and Wonder

skill.name: A Tale of Joy and Wonder

The companion trigger (in passiveTriggers) grants a marked ally Essence each time they use a new skill during the window. 'Keeper's allies' read as his allied heroes excluding Keeper.
