passive.name: Ambush
passive.description: Skills Laria uses while affected by Vanish deal double damage
passive.note: 'Double damage' is a multiplicative outgoing modifier the DSL cannot express: outgoing_damage_mod is additive, and no value ref exposes the event's own damage amount. Modeled as a damageDealt react that re-deals what Laria just dealt while the Vanish damage_reduction is on her.

effect.note: Deals the amount Laria just dealt again to the unit she hit, doubling it; must not re-trigger on this second hit.

skill.name: Severance
skill.note: 10 Affliction + 10 per Deepening Shadows stack on the target (read before removal), then all Deepening Shadows on the target are removed.

passive.name: Cursed Shadows
passive.description: Cursed units or units with 4 stacks of Deepening Shadows have their skills costs increased by 1 Generic energy. Using a skill will remove 1 stack of Deepening Shadows.
passive.note: Clause 1 is a continuous conditional cost aura (Cursed OR >=4 Deepening Shadows -> +1 generic cost). cost_mod carries no generic/specific pool field, so the 'Generic' scoping is noted; recomputed at roundStart (mid-round changes are the known stack-keyed-aura limitation). Clause 2 strips 1 Deepening Shadows whenever any unit uses a skill.

passiveTriggers.note: +1 generic skill cost on Cursed units or units at >=4 Deepening Shadows; recomputed at round start.
'Using a skill will remove 1 stack of Deepening Shadows' - the acting unit loses one stack (guarded so it only fires if they hold at least one).

skill.name: Curse of Darkness

onExpire.note: Fires only on NATURAL expiry (the holder never acted — otherwise removeMarkOnSkillUse stripped the mark, and removeStatus does not fire onExpire). Copies the full curse onto a random living ally hero of the holder by re-running lariacurse1's effects at full duration ('copy itself').

effects.note: Cancel: if the cursed holder uses ANY skill during the 3-turn window, strip the Curse of Darkness MARK via removeStatus (which does NOT fire onExpire), so no copy is made. owner:'target' parks the watch on the HOLDER (not Laria), so acting cancels the copy even if Laria has died and even if the holder is stealthed; its expiry stays anchored to Laria, in lockstep with the mark.

skill.note: 15 Affliction/turn for 3 turns (dot) plus 1 Deepening Shadows each of those turns (three scheduled stacks). If the holder never uses a skill during the mark's 3 turns, the mark survives to natural expiry and its onExpire copies the full curse onto a random living ally hero (copyCurseIfNoSkillUsed, re-running these effects so the copy is itself spreadable + cancelable); acting even once strips the mark early (removeMarkOnSkillUse) so no copy fires.

passive.name: In Between
passive.description: If Laria uses Vanish or Nightwrap on herself, she will ignore Harmful effects for 1 turn. This effect has a 2 turn Cooldown.
passive.note: skillUsed carries no skill id, so it is gated on Laria using a self-targeted skill (declaredTargetsSelf) as a proxy for Vanish or self-cast Nightwrap. 'Ignore Harmful effects' = non_damage_ignore (repo convention). The 2-turn internal cooldown is the 'In Between CD' self mark.

effect.note: Spirit Away window: In Between also applies its effect to the linked hero. The 25 true damage lands only if that hero is an enemy (enemies-filtered with-selector); the shared In Between ignore lands on the linked hero whether ally or enemy (all-faction with-selector).

skill.name: Spirit Away
skill.note: 'For her next two turns, if Laria triggers In Between she also applies its effects to target hero; if that hero is an enemy they first take 25 true damage.' A 2-turn self 'Spirit Away' mark flags the active window; a 'Spirit Away Target' mark on the chosen hero is the readable link (a with-selector resolves it — the unitRef alone is unreadable by authored effects). The linked payload (25 true if the hero is an enemy + shared In Between non_damage_ignore) fires from the In Between passiveTrigger while Spirit Away is up.

passive.name: Dark Matter
passive.description: When Laria uses Vanish, all stacks of Deepening Shadows on the field return to her, dealing 5 damage or healing to the character that had them. This transfer ignores the stack limit on Deepening Shadows.
passive.note: 'Uses Vanish' detected via the freshly applied 'Vanish' damage_reduction on self (same proxy as base laria4). Each character holding Deepening Shadows: their stacks are added to Laria ignoring the cap, that character takes a flat 5 (enemy) or heals 5 (ally), then their stacks are cleared.

passiveTriggers.note: 'ignores the stack limit' -> stacks are added to Laria without the 3-cap. faction:all includes Laria; returning her own stacks to herself is a net no-op and heals her 5.

skill.name: Dark Matter Beam
skill.note: 10 damage per Deepening Shadows stack on Laria (read before removal), then consumes all of her Deepening Shadows.

passive.name: Black Reflection
passive.description: Whenever another Hero reaches 4 stacks of Deepening Shadows, Laria will swap her current HP with theirs.
passive.note: Fires when a Deepening Shadows stack applied to a non-self hero brings them to >=4 stacks. No swap-HP primitive exists, so the current-HP exchange is a custom op.

effect.note: Swap Laria's current HP with the hero who just reached 4 Deepening Shadows stacks.

passiveTriggers.note: 'another Hero' -> eventUnit is a hero and not Laria; assumes statusApplied fires on Deepening Shadows stack gains with the recipient as eventUnit.

'the first harmful skill used on target ally is reflected back to its user': a Harmful skill declared on a Shadow-Rebound-warded ally reflects to its caster (redirectTo eventSource). removeStatus consumes the ward so only the FIRST harmful skill reflects; the mark's 1-turn duration bounds the window.

skill.name: Shadow Rebound
skill.note: Arms a 1-turn reflect ward on target ally: the first Harmful skill used on them is reflected back to its user (a companion HeroTrigger kind:'reflect' reads this mark). 'Invisible until revealed' = the ward stays hidden until it fires.

passive.name: Full Moon's Night
passive.description: Nightfall no longer makes characters invulnerable, lasts 4 turns, and causes characters with 3 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows to become Mooncursed. (Mooncursed characters have their Strategic skills stunned, deal 5 more non-affliction damage, and suffer 10 Affliction damage each turn.)
passive.note: Overrides base Nightfall (laria5): removing its invulnerable clause and extending its window to 4 turns are rewrites of laria5, not additive triggers, so they are noted only. On Laria's Nightfall use, every character with >=3 Deepening Shadows becomes Mooncursed for 4 turns (Strategic skills stunned, +5 non-affliction outgoing, 10 affliction/turn). skillUsed cannot gate on skill id, so it is gated on Laria's use plus the >=3-stack filter.

effect.note: Full Moon's Night: 'Nightfall no longer makes characters invulnerable.' Nightfall (laria5) applies invulnerable to all as it resolves; this post-resolution trigger strips it, so the net effect is no invulnerability.

passiveTriggers.note: Intended to fire only on Nightfall; skill-id gating is unavailable so it fires on any Laria skill use and applies Mooncursed(4) to not-yet-Mooncursed units at >=3 Deepening Shadows. +5 non-affliction = outgoing_damage_mod (engine restricts it to normal/piercing).

skill.name: Mooncurse
skill.note: 'cannot be applied to units already affected by it' -> gated on the target not already carrying the Mooncursed dot. Applies for 3 turns: Strategic skills stunned (stun scoped to Strategic), +5 non-affliction (outgoing_damage_mod), 10 affliction/turn (dot).

passive.name: Deep, Dark Night
passive.description: Once enemy heroes have a total of 10 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows, you can see all invisible effects created by your opponent. Once allied heroes have a total of 10 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows, all allied effects become invisible.
passive.note: Two visibility toggles keyed on summed Deepening Shadows. 'See invisible effects' has no status kind (it reveals the opponent's veiled/hidden effects) -> custom. 'Allied effects become invisible' = veiled applied to allied heroes. Recomputed at round start; sums can change mid-round (noted).

passiveTriggers.note: Recomputed each turnStart (NOT roundStart: clearRoundStatuses wipes the Deepening Shadows stacks before a roundStart trigger could read them). Enemy branch: while enemy heroes hold 10+ TOTAL Deepening Shadows (stackSum), Laria's team holds `reveal` (True Sight — redactState stops hiding the opponent's Invisible effects). Ally branch: while allied heroes hold 10+ total, all allied heroes are `veiled`, so their effects are Invisible to the enemy. Both toggle off via the else-branch when the total drops below 10, and reset with the stacks at round start.

skill.name: Snuff Out
skill.note: 3 Deepening Shadows added ignoring the cap, then the target is executed (defeat) if currentHp < Deepening Shadows x 5, measured after the 3 stacks are added.

passive.name: Shadow Clones
passive.description: Whenever Laria would create one or more stacks of Deepening Shadows, she instead creates a Shadow Clone minion. Shadow Clones are treated as if they are stacks of Deepening Shadows on all targets.
passive.note: 'Would create' is approximated by reacting to a Deepening Shadows stack Laria applies, removing it, and summoning a Shadow Clone (larianinjaminion) instead. 'Shadow Clones count as Deepening Shadows stacks' is real: the Shadow Clone template carries a Deepening Shadows stack (magnitude 1), so field-wide stackSum/count reads of Deepening Shadows count each live clone (a per-unit stackCount of a specific hero does not include clones - a minor residual).

passiveTriggers.note: Converts a Deepening Shadows stack Laria places into a Shadow Clone minion instead (one clone per creation event). The 'clones count as stacks on all targets' rule is a global read handled outside this effect.

skill.name: Shadow Cross
skill.note: Laria becomes invulnerable 1 turn, summons a Shadow Clone (larianinjaminion), deals 15 Piercing. The 'Shadow Cross' 1-turn mark makes Shadow Strike (shadowclone1) deal +10 to that target until end of turn; source-scoped damage bonuses have no status field, so the bonus is carried on the mark and read by the clone's skill.

passive.name: Ritual of Culling Night
passive.description: Laria's Ritual gains 1 Ritual Power for each stack of Deepening Shadows on the field at the end of each turn. Once her Ritual has reached 50 Ritual Power, Laria will consume her Ritual to deal 45 affliction damage to all heroes not affected by Nightcloak Candle.
passive.note: 'Ritual Power' modeled as a Ritual Power stack resource on Laria. turnEnd fires for BOTH teams, so 'each turn' is approximate. Each turn-end: gain Ritual Power equal to total Deepening Shadows on the field; at >=50, consume the whole Ritual and deal 45 affliction to every hero without the Nightcloak Candle mark.

passiveTriggers.note: 'each stack of Deepening Shadows on the field' = summed stacks across all units. At 50+ the whole Ritual is consumed (all Ritual Power removed).

'any enemy who uses a harmful skill on [a Nightcloak-marked ally] takes 5 Affliction, is marked 1 turn, and generates 5 Ritual Power.' skillUsed carries tags+targets: eventHasTag Harmful + enemy eventSource + a Nightcloak-marked eventTargets identifies the retaliation. The 5 Ritual Power lands on Laria (self, the trigger owner). No recursion (the retaliation is a damage op, sourced from Laria).

skill.name: Nightcloak Candle
skill.note: 'does not stack' -> gated on the target not already marked. Grants 1 Deepening Shadows, a permanent Nightcloak Candle mark, and +5 non-affliction outgoing damage. The retaliation clause (enemies who use a Harmful skill on the marked ally take 5 affliction, are marked 1 turn, and generate 5 Ritual Power) is a standing reaction carried by the Nightcloak Candle mark, not part of this one-shot effects array.

passive.name: Evencoin
passive.description: Each battle, the first enemy Hero to deal a killing blow receives 1 Evencoin. Characters with Evencoins are treated as though they have triple their actual stacks of Deepening Shadows.
passive.note: Clause 1: the first enemy hero to land a kill this battle gains an Evencoin stack, once per battle (lock via the permanent 'Evencoin Given' mark on Laria); killer read as eventSource of unitDied. Clause 2: Evencoin holders count as 3x their Deepening Shadows - a global counting reinterpretation with no primitive, carried as a standing custom rule.

passiveTriggers.note: 'first enemy Hero to deal a killing blow' -> first unitDied whose killer (eventSource) is an enemy hero; 'each battle' -> permanent 'Evencoin Given' lock so it awards only once.

effect.note: Units holding an Evencoin are counted as having triple their actual Deepening Shadows stacks wherever stack counts are read.

passiveTriggers.note: Static counting rule; no DSL primitive for a x3 stack multiplier, so carried as a custom global read.

skill.name: Midnight Justice
skill.note: 25 damage (35 vs an Evencoin holder). 'above 50 health' checked after the damage -> non-Strategic skills stunned 1 turn (stun scoped except Strategic). Evencoin holder -> +10 damage and this skill's cooldown zeroed (modifyCooldown -99). Repo caveat: a skill zeroing its OWN cooldown mid-cast is currently clobbered by the scheduler setting currentCd after effects run.

passive.name: Blighted Witch
passive.description: When Maggie falls below 70 HP or 30 HP, all enemy skills cost 1 more [65] for 1 turn.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Falls below 70 or 30 HP' modeled as: when Maggie takes damage and is left under 70 HP, all enemy skills cost +1 for 1 turn. HP-threshold CROSSING has no event, so this fires on any hit taken while below 70 (the 30 band is subsumed) rather than exactly once per crossing. cost_mod carries no energy channel, so the '[65]' generic-energy token is a flat +1.

Active-support reaction for Bog Witch's Bargain (maggieblight1): a fusion form's only standing-trigger channel is passiveTriggers, so the windowed 'if the marked enemy uses a new skill' punish lives here (mirrors how base Grasping Vines' rider sits in Maggie's hero triggers). Consuming the mark makes the scheduled timeout branch (stun + self-heal) no-op.

effects.note: Duration 2 (not 1) so the mark OUTLIVES the duration-tick that coincides with the scheduled timeout: in endTurn, tickDurations runs BEFORE fireScheduled, so a duration-1 mark would be removed the same turn-end the timeout fires, killing its 'did not act -> stun + heal' guard. With 2, the mark is still present when the timeout checks it; the timeout's own removeStatus then clears it. Both resolution paths (punish on act, timeout on no-act) remove the mark explicitly.

Timeout branch ('if they do not' act): one turn later, if the target still carries the mark (the skillUsed punish did not consume it), stun it 1 turn and Maggie heals 35. The 35-Affliction + permanent non_damage_ignore branch fires from the passiveTriggers reaction instead.

passive.name: Thorn Siphon
passive.description: Maggie's allies heal 5 HP each time Curse of Thorns deals damage.

effect.note: Heal each of Maggie's living allies 5 HP, but only when the damage instance's sourceId is the 'Curse of Thorns' dot. No Condition inspects an event's dtype or sourceId, so the named-dot gate needs the escape hatch; the outer when (eventSource == self) is a cheap pre-filter since Maggie is the applier of all Curse of Thorns damage (self dot and Bloodbind's enemy dot).

effects.note: Extends Maggie's Curse of Thorns onto the target enemy for 3 turns as a same-named affliction dot ticking 5 x Maggie's current Curse of Thorns stacks. Magnitude snapshots at cast (a dot's magnitude only refreshes on re-application), so later stack gains do not grow this instance.

passive.name: Touch of Finality
passive.description: Units damaged by Curse of Thorns cannot be healed for 1 turn.

effect.note: Apply a 1-turn heal_lock to the unit taking the damage, but only when the damage instance's sourceId is the 'Curse of Thorns' dot. sourceId/dtype gating has no Condition primitive, so the named-dot filter uses the escape hatch; the outer when (eventSource == self) pre-filters to Maggie-sourced damage.

effects.note: Enemy is permanently 'affected by Curse of Thorns': a stack (so stack-readers see it) plus a same-named affliction dot at 5 x Maggie's current stacks. duration null = permanent, matching 'permanently'. Magnitude snapshots at cast.

passive.name: Asmodeus's Promise
passive.description: Once Maggie has at least 5 stacks of Curse of Thorns, she applies it to any enemy she damages.

passiveTriggers.note: While Maggie holds >= 5 Curse of Thorns stacks, every enemy she damages gains Curse of Thorns (a stack + a same-named affliction dot scaling 5 x that enemy's own stacks). Guard on eventSource == self keeps it to Maggie's own hits. Null (permanent) dots model the lasting status but do not tick under the engine's dot rule.

passive.name: Sweet Torment
passive.description: Whenever Maggie deals damage to an ally, she deals 5 more non-Affliction damage permanently.

passiveTriggers.note: Each time Maggie damages an ally (herself excluded), her permanent outgoing damage grows by 5. Made cumulative via a hidden 'Sweet Torment' counter because only kind:stack accumulates (a bare outgoing_damage_mod re-apply would refresh, capping at +5). outgoing_damage_mod covers normal/piercing = 'non-Affliction'.

effects.name: Curse of Thorns
effects.note: 'Transferance Contract': the target ally receives all of Maggie's Curse of Thorns stacks (count copied before removal), plus the matching dot, and Maggie is cleared of both stacks and dot. passive.name: Spectral Growth
passive.description: Whenever an enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 stack of Spectral Growth. Maggie's damaging skills will remove these stacks to heal her for 5 HP per stack.

passiveTriggers.note: Hooked on skillDeclared, not skillUsed, because only skillDeclared carries class tags; eventHasTag 'Strategic' gates the enemy's Strategic casts.

effects.note: 25 damage, or 35 if the target carries the base Bramblelash mark (maggie1). Bypassing is the class tag; damage stays normal-typed.

passive.name: Graveyard Wanderer
passive.description: Maggie gains 10 Damage Reduction for each dead Hero in the battle.

passiveTriggers.note: Recompute the DR aura whenever a hero on either team dies. damage_reduction magnitude = 10 x current dead-hero count; re-applying refreshes the magnitude (only kind:stack accumulates). The roundStart copy re-seeds it each round (dead count starts at 0).

Active-support reaction for Bloodrose Offering (maggiegrave1), registered in passiveTriggers (the fusion form's only standing-trigger channel). If the ally marked by the active dies inside the 1-turn window, Maggie heals 10 x her Curse of Thorns stacks.

effects.note: 1-turn window mark on the ally; the death payoff is the 'Bloodrose Offering' passiveTriggers reaction keyed on this mark. 'This effect is invisible' is real: the skill-level isHidden conceals both the cast telegraph and this mark from the opponent (redactState), matching the peer fusion actives.

passive.name: Lash of Servitude
passive.description: If Maggie kills an enemy Hero, she creates a Revenant minion with their 3 Basic skills and 25 HP.

effect.note: On unitDied, eventSource binds to the killer, so sameUnit(eventSource, self) means Maggie landed the kill. She raises a Revenant at 25 HP. The Revenant inheriting the dead hero's 3 Basic skills is not expressible via summon (no skill-copy primitive), so the 'Revenant' template stands in and the inherited kit is a documented gap.
Populate the just-summoned Revenant with deep-clones of the killed heros 3 Basic skills (klass basic). The summon op above already created it; this only fills its kit (no re-summon).

passiveTriggers.note: Active-support reaction for Icebite Briars (maggielich1), registered in passiveTriggers. While the 4-turn window mark is up, each enemy Maggie damages deals 5 less non-Affliction damage (outgoing_damage_mod -5, normal/piercing) for 1 turn.

effects.note: 'Curse of Thorns will not damage her' for 4 turns = affliction/name-scoped damage_ignore (same primitive as base The Thornborn Witch).
4-turn window marker that gates the weaken reaction registered in passiveTriggers.

passive.name: Manipulated Movements
passive.description: If Maggie is affected with a new stun effect, she receives 1 stack of Curse of Thorns and removes that stun effect.

passiveTriggers.note: statusApplied binds its subject as eventUnit (event field is 'unit', not 'target'). has:stun of self confirms the applied status is a stun (no Condition reads the event's kind). Maggie converts the incoming stun into a Curse of Thorns stack and strips the stun.

effects.note: Immortal for 3 turns; onExpire defeat = 'at the end of this skill's duration, the target dies' (defeat bypasses the just-expired immortal). In onExpire, 'target' binds to the status bearer (the ally).

'During this time they can only target Maggie or enemies affected by Bramblelash' for 3 turns. No primitive expresses a multi-option targeting restriction (taunt forces a single unit), so the constraint uses the escape hatch.

passive.name: Sanguine Craving
passive.description: Maggie now receives an additional stack of Curse of Thorns when she uses a skill, and will receive 1 stack if she does not act on her turn.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Receives an ADDITIONAL stack of Curse of Thorns when she uses a skill' = base +1 (the fusion replaces the base Curse-on-skill trigger) PLUS the additional +1 = 2 per skill. Authored as +2 here rather than making the base trigger innate, which would wrongly persist into the devil/grave forms that replace the Curse behavior.

effect.note: 'Will receive 1 stack if she does not act on her turn.' No event marks 'did not act' (the actedThisTurn ledger must be inspected) and turnEnd carries only team, not the unit, so both the inaction test and my-turn scoping need the escape hatch.

passive.name: Alchemist's Fire
passive.description: Dealing damage to an enemy while Pyrrha has Bottled Flame will apply an additional 5 Affliction damage for 4 turns.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Dealing damage to an enemy while Pyrrha has Bottled Flame' -> react to Pyrrha's own damageDealt (eventSource=self) on an enemy while she bears the Bottled Flame mark; 'an additional 5 Affliction damage for 4 turns' is a 5/turn affliction dot for 4 turns on the struck enemy. Bottled Flame = the mark the active grants. The dealing skill is irrelevant (prose is generic 'dealing damage'); her Fan the Flames dot ticks are also 'dealing damage' and re-arm this while Bottled Flame is up.

effects.name: Fan the Flames
effects.note: 'Removes Fan the Flames from target enemy.'
'giving Pyrrha Elemental Essence'
'and a Bottled Flame for 3 turns' -> a 3-turn self mark the passive reads.

passive.name: Ice Age
passive.description: Damaging an enemy with Feed the Fire now also lowers the target's damage by 5 for their next 2 turns.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Damaging an enemy with Feed the Fire now also lowers the target's damage by 5 for their next 2 turns.' Reactive add-on scoped to Feed the Fire via {eventSourceId:'pyrrha2'} (the damageDealt event's sourceId is the casting skill id when the node is untagged): a -5 outgoing_damage_mod for 2 turns on an enemy struck specifically by pyrrha2. outgoing_damage_mod scales only normal/piercing damage (engine), matching 'lowers their damage'.

effects.note: 'Deals 35 damage to all enemies.' dtype defaults to normal (unspecified).

'and for 1 turn, if that enemy becomes invulnerable, they are stunned for 1 turn.' No declarative watch primitive exists: this arms a 1-turn window on each hit enemy so that gaining Invulnerable within it applies a 1-turn full stun. An active's effect tree cannot register a conditional reaction; custom pending a native watch/trigger-install primitive.

passive.name: Festering Burns
passive.description: Fan the Flames is now permanent and stacks, but is no longer affected by Pyrokinesis.

effect.note: 'Fan the Flames is now permanent and stacks, but is no longer affected by Pyrokinesis.' Rewrites the Fan the Flames dot (applied by pyrrha1) to duration:null and a STACKING policy (each application adds a stack instead of refreshing), and removes Pyrokinesis's (pyrrha3) +5 modifyStatus node on the burn. Dot duration, DEFAULT_STACK_POLICY, and pyrrha3's effect tree are base-skill/stack-policy rewrites with no declarative trigger/status; applied idempotently at round start because the fusion passive channel offers only triggers, not skill patches.

effect.name: Sulphur Vent
effect.note: consume the window so only the FIRST enemy skill on Pyrrha is countered.
'If an enemy is successfully countered this way, they have a stack of Fan the Flames added to them.' Counter kind cancels the enemy's declared skill; the stack lands only on a successful counter.

passiveTriggers.note: The Sulphur Vent counter, installed by the form but gated on the self mark the active applies, so it is dormant until Pyrrha uses Sulphur Vent. Counters (kind:counter) cancel the declared enemy skill; 'the first enemy ... on Pyrrha' = declaredTargetsSelf, one-shot via consuming the mark.

effects.note: 'Counters the first enemy to use a skill on Pyrrha for 1 turn.' Arms a 1-turn self mark; the companion counter trigger (in passiveTriggers) reads it, cancels that first enemy skill declared on Pyrrha, and consumes the mark. 'for 1 turn' = the mark's duration bounds the window.

passive.name: Flames of Greed
passive.description: Fan the Flames now affects all enemies, but also affects all allies.

effect.note: 'Fan the Flames now affects all enemies, but also affects all allies.' Rewrites pyrrha1's targeting to hit every unit on both teams (all enemies + all allies). A base-skill targeting rewrite with no reactive-trigger or status equivalent; applied idempotently at round start (fusion passives carry only triggers, not skill patches).

effects.note: 'Deals 40 Affliction damage to one enemy' + '... deals 10 more damage to the target ... each time it is used' -> 40 + 10*prior uses, uses tracked by the Mammon's Flame self-stack.
'and 20 Affliction damage to Pyrrha' + '... 10 more damage to ... Pyrrha each time' -> 20 + 10*prior uses (self affliction damage).

effects.name: Mammon's Flame
effects.note: increment the per-use counter AFTER both damages read it, so the Nth cast (0-indexed) adds +10*N.

'This skill costs 1 more [65] ([65]=Generic) ... each time it is used.' A per-use +1 generic cost is not expressible via static cost metadata or a cost Value; a custom deepens a pyrrhadevil1-scoped cost_mod by +1 generic per use (inverse of the registered decaySkillCost/scopedCostDiscountOnUse pattern).

passive.name: Dragon's Hunger
passive.description: Pyrrha deals 5 more damage and healing with Feed the Fire, and it targets all enemies currently affected by Fan the Flames.

effect.note: 'Pyrrha deals 5 more damage and healing with Feed the Fire, and it targets all enemies currently affected by Fan the Flames.' Rewrites pyrrha2 (Feed the Fire): +5 to its damage and +5 to its heal, and its target set becomes every enemy bearing the Fan the Flames dot instead of one. Base-skill amount+targeting rewrite; not expressible as a reactive trigger. Applied idempotently at round start.

effects.note: 'Deals 25 Affliction damage to one enemy and applies the damage-over-time portion of Fan the Flames' (the 5/turn, 3-turn affliction dot only, no initial 15 hit). 'While Pyrrha is at or below 30 HP, this skill targets all enemies' -> when currentHp<=30 the 25 damage + dot hit every enemy instead of the single target.

passive.name: Flames of Judgment
passive.description: Receiving damage from Fan the Flames or using a skill on Pyrrha or her allies gives enemies a stack of Flames of Judgment.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Receiving damage from Fan the Flames ... gives enemies a stack of Flames of Judgment.' The Fan the Flames dot ticks emit damageDealt with source=Pyrrha and sourceId 'Fan the Flames'; the trigger scopes to exactly those via {eventSourceId:'Fan the Flames'}. Pyrrha's direct hits (Pyrokinesis/Feed the Fire) carry their own skill-id sourceIds and do NOT count -- only the dot tick does.

'... or using a skill on Pyrrha or her allies gives enemies a stack.' An enemy (isFaction eventSource enemy) whose skill targets Pyrrha or an ally (isFaction eventTargets ally, from Pyrrha's perspective) gains a Flames of Judgment stack. The eventTargets faction gate (same predicate Sera's passive uses) scopes this to skills aimed at Pyrrha's team, so an enemy's self/ally-targeted skill no longer over-counts.

effects.note: 'Target enemy with 7 or more stacks of Flames of Judgment is instantly killed.' Applied to every enemy (targeting all): any bearing >=7 Flames of Judgment stacks is defeated. 'This skill Bypasses' -> the Bypassing tag (verbatim). 'cannot be countered or reflected' -> the Uncounterable tag on this skill, which interpret.ts honors by early-returning before the counter/reflect loop.

passive.name: Exhaust Fumes
passive.description: Enemies affected by Fan the Flames receive 10 Affliction damage if they target Pyrrha with a new skill.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Enemies affected by Fan the Flames receive 10 Affliction damage if they target Pyrrha with a new skill.' Reacts to an enemy that bears the Fan the Flames dot and used a skill whose targets include Pyrrha (declaredTargetsSelf), dealing 10 Affliction back to that enemy. skillUsed is the post-resolution point where 'targeted Pyrrha' is known declaratively.

'or until she uses a new skill': when Pyrrha (the only holder of the named Blastoff Invulnerable) uses a skill, the one-shot Blastoff Grace mark spares the Blastoff cast that applied it; her next skill has no grace, so the Invulnerable is stripped early. Mirrors the Cindersprig Brew / Drunken Swordsman cancel pattern.

effects.note: 'Deals 15 damage to all enemies.'

'and makes Pyrrha invulnerable for 2 turns, or until she uses a new skill.' A NAMED 2-turn Invulnerable so the Blastoff cancel trigger (passiveTriggers) can strip exactly it. 'or until she uses a new skill' = that skillUsed self-trigger; the one-shot 'Blastoff Grace' mark below spares the very cast (Blastoff itself) that applied the Invulnerable, so her NEXT skill is the one that ends it early.
One-shot grace: consumed by the Blastoff cancel trigger on Pyrrha's Blastoff cast itself, so the Invulnerable survives its own application and ends on her NEXT skill.

passive.name: Burning Plasma
passive.description: Fan the Flames now Shatters the affected enemy for its duration.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Fan the Flames now Shatters the affected enemy for its duration.' Fires specifically on the Fan the Flames APPLICATION (eventStatusKind dot 'Fan the Flames'), not on any status Pyrrha lands on a burning enemy; the not-Shattered guard stops re-firing on its own Shatter. Shatter duration 3 = Fan the Flames' base burn (always applied fresh at 3).

effects.note: 'Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy.'

then.note: 'they take an additional 5 damage' (dtype normal, unspecified).
'and Pyrrha gains Elemental Essence'

effects.note: 'If the enemy is Shattered, they take an additional 5 damage and Pyrrha gains Elemental Essence.'

passive.name: Ritual of Agony
passive.description: Pyrrha's Ritual gains 4 Ritual Power whenever a unit receives damage or dies. When this effect reaches 75 Ritual Power, all units will permanently receive double damage (this effect does not stack).

then.note: latch mark so the threshold effect applies once ('this effect does not stack').

'all units will permanently receive double damage' -> double (x2) is multiplicative with no declarative status (incoming_damage_mod is additive), so a custom applies a permanent damage-doubling to every unit. Guarded by stackCount>=75, so it never runs below threshold.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Pyrrha's Ritual gains 4 Ritual Power whenever a unit receives damage ...' Any damageDealt anywhere adds 4 to Pyrrha's Ritual Power stack; at >=75 the latched threshold effect fires once.

then.note: latch mark so the threshold effect applies once ('this effect does not stack').

'all units will permanently receive double damage' -> double (x2) is multiplicative with no declarative status (incoming_damage_mod is additive), so a custom applies a permanent damage-doubling to every unit. Guarded by stackCount>=75, so it never runs below threshold.

passiveTriggers.note: '... or dies.' A unit dying also adds 4 Ritual Power; same >=75 latch as the damage half.

effects.note: 'Deals 15 damage to an enemy or an ally' -> single target, either faction (targeting 'single'); dtype normal.

'and sets their max HP to their current HP.' No declarative op sets maxHp; a custom lowers the target's maxHp to its post-damage currentHp. Runs after the 15 damage so the cap reflects the reduced HP.

passive.name: Solar Flare
passive.description: Flashbang now costs [13] but affects all enemies.

effect.note: 'Flashbang now costs [13] but affects all enemies.' [13] = the Sun element cost icon (element id 13, Pyrrha's post-fusion element). Rewrites pyrrha4 (Flashbang) to cost 1 Sun (specific) and to target all enemies (its non-Strategic stun applies team-wide; Pyrrha's Invulnerable is unchanged). Base-skill cost+targeting rewrite with no reactive-trigger equivalent; applied idempotently at round start.

then.note: 'this skill deals an additional 10 damage' (dtype normal, unspecified).
'and removes Elemental Essence from them.'

passive.name: Unstable Waters
passive.description: Undertow now increases the damage taken by the target by 5 for 2 turns.

passiveTriggers.note: Undertow (riverdaughter2) now makes its target take +5 damage for 2 turns. Gated to Undertow via eventSkillId; eventTargets is Undertow's declared (single) target. (Previously used eventTarget, which does not resolve for skillUsed -- the effect landed on no one.)

passive.name: Fountain of Youth
passive.description: The target of Soothe is now also cleansed of all enemy effects.

effect.note: Soothe's target is cleansed of all enemy-applied (debuff) statuses. No removeStatus primitive strips 'all enemy effects' at once, so custom: the engine should remove every status on eventTarget whose source is an enemy. Intended for Soothe (riverdaughter4) only; gate on ctx.event.skillId==='riverdaughter4'.

effects.note: Heals all allied heroes and minions 10/turn for 3 turns. {faction:'allies'} with no kind restriction covers heroes and minions; includeSelf so River Daughter is healed too.

passive.name: Blood in the Water
passive.description: River Daughter stores all of the damage she deals to the enemy team. Whenever Healing Tears triggers, she heals her team for 10 additional health for every 40 damage stored, emptying the stored damage.

effect.note: Adds the damage just dealt (ctx.event.amount) to the 'Blood in the Water' stack on self. No ref exposes an event's damage amount, hence custom. Run Red (riverdaughterblood1) must be exempted from this store.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Whenever Healing Tears triggers' = River Daughter counters an enemy. Blood in the Water is ADDITIVE ('10 additional health'): first the BASE Healing Tears (regen 5/3 + essence, which replace-mode fusion had dropped), THEN +10 per full 40 damage stored, then empty the store.

'Whenever Healing Tears triggers' = River Daughter stuns an enemy (Healing Tears part 2). Same as the counter half: BASE Healing Tears (regen 5/3 + essence) THEN the +10-per-40 additional heal + empty.

effects.note: 20 damage, increased by 10 for every 20 damage stored in Blood in the Water.

effects.name: Blood in the Water

passive.name: Conducted Emotion
passive.description: Healing Tears now lasts one turn and heals 10 health, but it also activates whenever she gains Elemental Essence from another source. Triggering Healing Tears this way will not give River Daughter Elemental Essence.

passiveTriggers.note: Conducted Emotion redefines Healing Tears to heal 10 for 1 turn (was 5 for 3). Part 1: on countering an enemy, heal team 10 for 1 turn and gain Elemental Essence.
Part 2: on stunning an enemy, same 10/1 team heal + Elemental Essence.

Healing Tears also activates whenever River Daughter gains Elemental Essence FROM ANOTHER SOURCE: heal team 10/1, grant NO essence. Gated on the applied status being an elemental_essence (eventStatusKind) landing on her (eventUnit==self) from ANOTHER unit (eventSource != self) -- so essence she grants herself via Healing Tears' own counter/stun halves does not re-fire this (the loop the author flagged), and only a genuinely external essence gain triggers it. eventStatusKind also stops the self-recursion the old has(essence,eventUnit) gate caused (its regen application re-entered).

effects.name: Catalytic Nova
effects.note: Increases the damage of River Daughter's next Ripple by 10, stacking infinitely. Base Ripple (riverdaughter1) must read this stack as bonus AoE damage and clear it on use.
If Catalytic Nova was also used last turn (chain mark still present), River Daughter gains Elemental Essence.
Arms a 1-turn chain window so using this again on the following turn grants Essence.

passive.name: Winter Flow
passive.description: Soothe now heals the ally for 5 health on the first turn, 10 health on the second, and 15 on the third turn.

effect.name: Soothe
effect.note: Winter Flow REPLACES Soothe's base 10/2 regen with the 5/10/15 escalation: strip the just-applied base Soothe regen from the target, then schedule the escalating heals.

Soothe now heals the ally 5 on turn 1, 10 on turn 2, 15 on turn 3. Replaces Soothe's base 10/turn-for-2 regen (base skill riverdaughter4 cannot be edited from a fusion form; the engine should suppress its regen when this applies). Intended for Soothe only; gate on ctx.event.skillId==='riverdaughter4'. Escalating (non-flat) amounts are not expressible as one regen status, hence custom.

effects.note: The following turn, the same ally gains 10 shield for 1 turn. Scheduled effect is anchored to 'target', which persists to the later turn (per the schedule precedent).

passive.name: Reflection of Kindness
passive.description: River Daughter stores all healing received by the enemy team. Each time she accumulates 50 total healing, she gains Elemental Essence and deals 15 Affliction damage to all enemies.

effect.note: Adds the healing an enemy just received (ctx.event.amount) to the 'Reflection of Kindness' tally on self. No ref exposes an event's heal amount, hence custom.
Also record the healing on the healed enemy itself, tagged by the current round, so Party Crasher can read 'healing received LAST round'.

then.note: spendStack LOOPS per 50 stored: each iteration spends 50, grants Elemental Essence, and deals 15 Affliction to all enemies. So it handles the essence + damage itself (do NOT also apply them here, or they double) and correctly fires twice at 100, once at 50.

effect.note: Each time the stored enemy-healing reaches 50, River Daughter gains Elemental Essence and deals 15 Affliction to all enemies, spending 50 (all via spendStack).

effects.note: Sum the target's HealingReceived stack from the PREVIOUS round into ctx.vars.healingReceivedLastRound, which the bonus-damage op below reads (same ctx.vars).
Bonus damage equal to the healing the target received last round (loadHealingLastRound populated the var from the previous round's HealingReceived stack on the target).

passive.name: Shallows Dance
passive.description: River Daughter starts each round under the effect of Dive, but it no longer makes her invulnerable. Instead, while Dive is active, River Daughter deals 10 piercing damage to any enemy that uses a harmful skill.

effect.note: River Daughter starts each round under Dive (a stance mark) WITHOUT invulnerability. duration null = lasts the round; Shallow Slash reactivates/refreshes it. roundStart fires for both teams; should apply only on River Daughter's side.

passiveTriggers.note: While Dive is active, River Daughter deals 10 piercing to any enemy that uses a Harmful skill. skillDeclared carries class tags (skillUsed does not), so Harmful is gated via eventHasTag.

effects.note: If used from Dive, reactivates (refreshes) the Dive stance.

passive.name: Triton's Blessing
passive.description: Healing Tears is now triggered whenever an enemy uses a Strategic skill. Heroes can only have one heal-over-time effect from Triton's Blessing at a time.

passiveTriggers.note: Healing Tears (part 1) still fires on countering an enemy. The heal-over-time is named 'Triton's Blessing' so a hero holds only one copy at a time (re-applying refreshes, not stacks).
Healing Tears (part 2) still fires on stunning an enemy.
NEW: Healing Tears is now also triggered whenever an enemy uses a Strategic skill (skillDeclared carries class tags). Same named 5/3 team heal-over-time (one per hero) + Elemental Essence.

effects.note: Channel, indefinite (channelTurns null): the engine re-runs this 20 damage to the target at each of River Daughter's turns until she stops Channeling (interrupted, stunned, or acts otherwise).

passive.name: Toxic Waste

effects.note: Stuns the target's Strategic skills for 1 turn (a silence scoped to Strategic-tagged skills). If used from Dive, 2 turns instead. 'Used from Dive' is proxied by River Daughter currently holding invulnerable (base Dive, riverdaughter5, grants 1-turn invulnerability); no generic 'Dive' state exists in the base kit.

passive.name: Bubbling Mire

Enemies who deal new damage to a Slime minion take 5 Affliction. Restricted to River Daughter's Slime minions (template riverdaughterslimeminion) as a note, since isKind only distinguishes hero/minion; 'new damage' = fresh HP damage (pure shield chip excluded).
Congeal is automatically cast whenever Healing Tears activates (part 1: on countering an enemy). Auto-cast lives here because an active skill cannot carry its own trigger.
Congeal auto-cast when Healing Tears activates (part 2: on stunning an enemy).

No primitive converts overheal into Max HP, hence custom. targeting 'all-allies' from the frozen 'all' + Helpful; effect is scoped to Slime minions. This skill is also auto-cast whenever Healing Tears activates (see passive triggers).

passive.note: unitDied gated on the dying unit being Roland's ally; the condition vocab has no template predicate, so the 'non-Boulder, non-Zombie' exclusion (which prevents a spawn loop off the Boulders/Zombies this form creates) cannot be expressed and must be enforced by the engine.

skill.note: Consumes every active Boulder to create one Zombie per Boulder: iterate Roland's Boulder minions, summoning a Zombie and defeating (consuming) each.

passive.description: Boulder minions now have Living Lash.

effect.note: Boulder minions gain the Living Lash active (rolandlivingboulder1). Hooks minion CREATION (minionSummoned) — Boulders are only made mid-round by Form Stone, so a roundStart sweep would find none.
