passive.name: Mag-Lev Pillars
passive.description: Boulders gain 15 Shield for 2 turns whenever an enemy is affected by Earth Pillar.
passive.note: statusApplied keyed on eventUnit (the newly-affected unit) being an enemy that now holds the 'Earth Pillar' mark; the engine exposes no event-status-kind condition, so this over-fires only if an already-Earth-Pillar-marked enemy later receives some other status.

effects.note: 'Target Boulder taunts all enemies for 1 turn' — put a taunt on every enemy whose unitRef points at the target Boulder, so legalTargets forces their single-target Harmful skills onto it. (A bare taunt on the Boulder would never redirect, since the redirect reads the ATTACKER's own taunt.unitRef.)

'On the following turn that Boulder deals double damage to any enemy it damages' - next turn the target Boulder gains an outgoing_damage_mult x2 (named 'Magnetized') for 1 turn, which the damage pipeline reads to double every hit the Boulder deals (including its SFtE launch, whose damage is credited to the Boulder via from:target).

passive.name: Moonfield
passive.description: Each time Earth Pillar has been used or a Boulder has been launched with Strength From The Earth, Roland gains one stack of Stonefield Stalker.
passive.note: Two skillUsed triggers, both gated only on eventSource == self; skillUsed carries no skill identity in the condition vocab, so 'the skill was Earth Pillar' (roland2) and 'Strength From The Earth (roland1) launched a Boulder' cannot be enforced and are described per-trigger. As authored, any self skill use grants a stack from each trigger (over-fires).

passiveTriggers.note: Only when Earth Pillar (roland2) is used -> +1 Stonefield Stalker (eventSkillId gate).
Only when Strength From The Earth (roland1) launches a Boulder (target is a Boulder minion) -> +1 Stonefield Stalker.
While Mooncursed, Strength From The Earth (roland1.hit) deals 15 additional to an Earth-Pillar-marked target. The rider's own damage carries no roland1.hit sourceId, so it does not re-fire.

skill.name: Stonefield Stalker
skill.note: Applies Mooncursed for 1 + (Stonefield Stalker stacks) turns - stackCount read before the stacks are consumed - then removes all stacks. The '+15 damage on Strength From The Earth to Earth-Pillar targets while Mooncursed' rider lives on Strength From The Earth (roland1), which reads the Mooncursed mark.

passive.name: Spires of the North
passive.description: Earth Pillar can now be used on allies, giving them 15 permanent Shield and making them invulnerable to Strategic skills for 2 turns.
passive.note: The targeting change ('Earth Pillar can now target allies') is not expressible as a trigger and is noted only. The rider is reactive: when the 'Earth Pillar' mark lands on an ally (statusApplied, eventUnit an ally that now holds Earth Pillar), that ally gains 15 permanent Shield and 2-turn invulnerability scoped to Strategic skills.

passive.name: Mark the Path
passive.description: Enemies damaged by Boulders are permanently marked by Mark the Path. Allies Bypass when targeting enemies affected by Mark the Path.
passive.note: First clause is reactive: on damageDealt where the source is an allied minion (intended: a Boulder - no template predicate exists in the condition vocab) and the target an enemy, apply the permanent 'Mark the Path' mark. Second clause ('Allies Bypass when targeting Mark-the-Path enemies') is a global targeting/defense-bypass rule with no reactive event and no 'bypass' status kind; noted for the engine only.

skill.name: FInal Warning
skill.note: Casts Strength From The Earth (roland1) on every enemy hero marked by 'Mark the Path' and on every active Boulder (which SFtE launches).

passive.name: Soothing Stone
passive.description: Allies affected by Living Stone's shield heal 5 HP each turn.
passive.note: turnStart fires for both teams, so this ticks at the start of every team's turn; intended cadence is once per turn. 'Affected by Living Stone's shield' is read as holding the round-permanent 'Living Stone' mark that Living Stone's shield grant applies (and that clears when that shield breaks).

skill.name: Sanctus Terra
skill.note: 'Can only be used if Roland has exactly 4 Boulder minions' is a cast precondition, modeled as an if-guard (count of allied Boulder minions == 4) around 45 damage to the enemy team.

passive.name: Oozeshaping
passive.description: Creating Boulder minionss now instead creates two Slimeball minions. Strength from the Earth can be used to launch a Slimeball like it's a Boulder, stunning any enemy damaged by it.
passive.note: First clause is a summon-substitution rule (each Boulder creation becomes two Slimeballs) with no reactive event and no substitution op; noted for the engine. Second clause: Strength From The Earth (roland1) can launch a Slimeball (a targeting change, noted) and any enemy it damages is stunned - modeled reactively as an allied minion (intended: a launched Slimeball) dealing damage to an enemy applies a 1-turn stun.

passiveTriggers.note: Intended: only when a Slimeball is launched via Strength From The Earth (no template predicate in the condition vocab).

skill.name: Call to the Mire
skill.note: 'For 2 turns, Slimeballs are immune to damage and one is created each turn': the immediate Slimeball is summoned FIRST, then a forEach grants every allied Slimeball (the fresh one included) 2-turn damage_ignore — so the newly-created Slimeball is immune too. One more Slimeball is scheduled next turn (also made immune for the window's remainder).

passive.name: Scattered Spores
passive.description: Whenever a Boulder is destroyed, create a Stonecap Mushroom minion. If Roland uses Strength from the Earth on a Stonecap Mushroom, he deals 15 Affliction damage to all enemy units, destroying the Stonecap Mushroom.
passive.note: First clause: on unitDied of an allied minion (intended: a Boulder - no template predicate available, and it must not fire for Stonecap deaths or it loops) summon a Stonecap Mushroom. Second clause: on Roland using Strength From The Earth (roland1) on a Stonecap Mushroom (skill identity and target template are not gateable in the condition vocab) deal 15 Affliction to all enemies and defeat that Stonecap; gated only on eventSource == self, with eventTarget as the consumed Stonecap.

passiveTriggers.note: Only a Boulder's death re-summons a Stonecap (isNamed gate) -- NOT a Stonecap's own death, which would otherwise spawn-loop once destroying a Stonecap via Strength From The Earth actually works.

Only when Strength From The Earth (roland1) is used on a Stonecap Mushroom: gated by eventSkillId + isNamed on the target. Deal 15 Affliction to all enemies and defeat that Stonecap. (Previously ungated on skill/target and used eventTarget, which does not resolve for skillUsed -- so the 15 damage fired on EVERY Roland skill and the defeat hit no one.)

skill.name: Loamwrecker
skill.note: 35 damage whose type and rider depend on minion counts: more Boulders than Stonecap Mushrooms -> Piercing plus 15 Shield to Roland; more Stonecaps than Boulders -> Affliction plus heal 10; tie -> plain 35.

passive.name: Exposure
passive.description: Enemies marked by Earth Pillar receive 10 Affliction damage per turn that they remain marked.
passive.note: Modeled on turnStart: every enemy currently holding the 'Earth Pillar' mark takes 10 Affliction. turnStart fires for both teams, so absent per-team scoping it ticks at the start of each team's turn; intended cadence is once per turn. A statusApplied->dot model was avoided because applying a dot re-fires statusApplied on the still-marked enemy and would loop.

skill.name: Molten Rockslide
skill.note: 'Launches all active Boulders at the target, 20 Affliction per Boulder': total = 20 x (allied Boulder count) to the target, then all Boulders are consumed (defeat). The target being Earth-Pillar-marked is the skill's targeting restriction (noted).

passive.name: Prismatic Shielding
passive.description: Plasma Shield now affects all allied Heroes, and lasts 2 turns.

effect.note: 'Plasma Shield now affects all allied Heroes, and lasts 2 turns.' When Saya casts Plasma Shield (saya4), grant its 40 Shield + affliction damage_ignore to every allied Hero instead of just her, and make the ignore last 2 turns instead of 1. Gated to saya4 via custom because skillUsed exposes no skill-id condition.

effects.note: 25 piercing + 10 per stack of Universal Energy Conduit on Saya.

passive.name: Storage Capacitor
passive.description: Saya gains an additional [65] every turn.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Saya gains an additional [65] every turn' ([65] = generic energy). turnStart carries only a team, no unit, so it cannot be gated to Saya's own turn; it ticks at every turn-start (known event-team-scoping limitation).

passive.name: Constant Flux
passive.description: Saya Coil deals a random amount between 10 less and 10 more damage than its base (in increments of 5).

effect.note: Constant Flux re-authors the Saya Coil turn-end tick so each coil deals its base (10; 20 while Enhanced) plus a random delta between -10 and +10 in increments of 5. Fusion replaces base triggers, so the coil tick is re-declared here with the variance folded in; no Value primitive rolls a random amount in a stepped range, hence custom.

effects.note: Target ally deals 5 more non-Affliction damage for 2 turns (scope excludes Affliction-tagged output).
'gains Elemental Essence each turn for 2 turns' modeled as two scheduled essence grants on the ally's next two turns.

passive.name: Miniature Ion Cannons
passive.description: Saya Coils can no longer be Enhanced and gain a maximum stack of 2, but are applied 2 at a time. Well-Used Panic Button will no longer consider or destroy Saya Coils.

effect.note: Static rule change with no reactive event: Saya Coils can no longer be Enhanced, cap at 2 stacks, and are applied 2 at a time; Well-Used Panic Button (replaced by this fusion passive anyway) no longer counts or destroys coils. Installed once at round start via custom because no op sets a skill/mechanic rule.

Re-declares the base Saya Coil per-turn damage (10 per coil to a random enemy at each turn-end). Fusion replace-mode wipes the base hero triggers, so the coil damage must be re-installed here (the storm/current sibling fusions do the same); the Enhanced term is dropped since ion coils can never be Enhanced.

effects.note: 'causes any active Saya Coils to immediately fire at them as well' — each active coil's tick damage (10 normal / 20 Enhanced) aggregated onto the target.

passive.name: Magnetic Field
passive.description: Whenever an enemy uses a Helpful or Harmful skill, they will gain positive or negative charge. If an enemy uses a Harmful skill while negatively charged or vice versa, they will receive 15 damage and be stunned for 1 turn. Using a Strategic skill removes all charge.

effect.note: Charge system keyed on the used skill's class: Helpful grants positive charge, Harmful grants negative charge, Strategic clears all charge. Using a skill whose polarity matches the enemy's existing charge (Harmful while negatively charged, or vice versa) discharges for 15 damage + 1-turn stun. skillUsed exposes no class tags to conditions, so the class routing and charge bookkeeping live in a custom fn.

effects.note: For 1 turn Saya counters the first Helpful or Harmful skill the target enemy uses; on a successful counter the target loses Elemental Essence and gains a Magnetic Charge matching the countered skill's class. A counter installed by an active plus class detection require a custom watch. Skill is invisible (frozen hidden:true).

passive.name: Direct Energy Line
passive.description: Whenever Saya gains Elemental Essence, she heals 10 Health. Saya cannot be healed in any other way.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Saya cannot be healed in any other way' — a permanent heal_lock blocks all conventional healing.

effect.note: When the status applied to Saya is Elemental Essence, heal 10 (her only healing source), bypassing the permanent heal_lock. Custom because the heal must ignore heal_lock and be gated to essence specifically; the has-essence guard approximates 'on gaining essence' (statusApplied is the only reactive hook).
Marks the 'turn after Direct Energy Line triggers' window that Plasma Cannon reads for its +10 Piercing bonus.

effects.note: Base 20; on the turn after Direct Energy Line triggers (its mark is up) it deals 10 more (30) and becomes Piercing.

passive.name: Shady Assistants
passive.description: Saya begins the round with a Shady Assistant minion.

effects.note: Creates a Monstrosity. Cost drops 1 Reanimation ([60], specificDelta) per dead allied Hero and 1 generic ([65], genericDelta) per dead enemy Hero. 'Limit 1' = requires no living Saya-Brand Monstrosity already on the field.

passive.name: Charged Environment
passive.description: Saya Coils now deal 10 damage to a second random enemy when they deal damage

effect.note: Base Saya Coil turn-end tick, re-authored because fusion replaces base triggers (10 per normal coil, 20 per Enhanced coil, aggregated onto a random enemy).
Charged Environment: each firing coil also deals 10 to a second random enemy (aggregated as 10 x coil count).

effects.note: Persistent: each of Saya's turns she deals 5 x her Lightning Rod stacks to a random enemy, and gains a Lightning Rod stack whenever she gains energy from Elemental Essence. 'Cannot be used once active' — a requires-gate on the Lightning Rod mark should block recast, but the fusion active only authors effects; the ongoing per-turn damage and stack-on-essence are self-installed reactive behavior, so they live in a custom watch.

passive.name: Reverberation
passive.description: When Saya damages a character, they deal 5 reduced damage permanently, stacking. This effect is removed if the target becomes invulnerable.

passiveTriggers.note: Each time Saya damages a character, they permanently deal 5 less damage; stacks:true accumulates -5 per hit (named Reverberation so it can be stripped when the target becomes invulnerable).
If a character becomes Invulnerable, their accumulated Reverberation reduction is removed.

effects.note: 20 damage, Bypassing (piercing).
If the target is Invulnerable: 10 additional damage and stunned for 1 turn.

passive.name: Overwatch
passive.description: Dealing damage to allied Heroes marks the enemy with Overwatch  for 2 turn.

passiveTriggers.note: When an enemy deals damage to one of Saya's allied Heroes, that enemy is marked with Overwatch for 2 turns (read by Orbital Strike).

effects.note: 20 Bypassing (piercing) damage to all enemies marked by Overwatch.

passive.name: Shieldmaiden
passive.description: Skylance now taunts its target and gives Syl 10 Shield for 1 turn.

effect.note: When Syl uses Skylance (syl2): Taunt its target onto Syl and grant Syl 10 Shield for 1 turn. No skill-id condition primitive exists to gate a skillUsed trigger to one skill, so this is a custom escape hatch.

effects.note: 35 True damage. 'Cannot be countered or reflected' is carried by the Uncounterable class tag.

passive.name: Great Roc
passive.description: Syl's Eagle minion's skills cost 1 more [65], but last 1 additional turn.

effect.note: Native half: +1 to the Eagle's skill costs (cost_mod on the holder). Applied at round start to Syl's only allied minion, her Eagle.
Other half: the Eagle's skill effects each last 1 additional turn. No primitive adds +1 to every effect duration a unit's skills apply, so this is a custom escape hatch.

Re-run after the Eagle evolves (Leyline Nest's transform re-instantiates the Eagle's skills fresh, losing the roundStart +1-turn bump). Firing on every Syl skillUsed is idempotent: the per-instance once-guard skips already-bumped skills and bumps only the fresh post-transform ones.

effects.note: Adds 10 damage and +1 stun turn to the target per growth stage Syl's Eagle has advanced THIS round (Hatchling->Adult->Ancient via Leyline Nest). No ref counts stages-evolved-this-round, so this is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Harrier
passive.description: Syl and her Eagle minion deal 5 less damage with their skills, but any time they damage an enemy, they become Invulnerable to Strategic skills for 1 turn.

effect.note: Syl and her Eagle deal 5 less damage with their skills. outgoing_damage_mod is normal/piercing-only, so Syl's Piercing Skylance and the Eagle's Piercing Talon Rake are reduced as intended.

'Invulnerable to Strategic skills for 1 turn' modeled as non_damage_ignore (immune to harmful non-damage effects) on the unit that just damaged an enemy - Strategic control skills are non-damage; the closest existing status, since invulnerable cannot be class-scoped.

effects.note: Summons 2 Sparrowrider minions (template sylfaerieminion). Their 'count as Syl's Eagle for triggering Two as One' clause hooks the base Two as One triggers, which fusion's default replace-semantics removes - an engine-gap noted, not re-implemented here.

passive.name: Silent Wingbeats
passive.description: Syl and her Eagle now Bypass against Isolated targets

effect.note: Syl and her Eagle's damage Bypasses (ignores Shield/DR) against Isolated targets. Conditional per-target bypass of a unit's outgoing damage has no primitive form, so this is a custom escape hatch.

effects.note: All units (both teams) become Isolated for 4 turns.
For those 4 turns Syl does not accrue Leyline Nest's per-turn cost reduction (its syl5 decaySkillCost mechanic is paused). No primitive pauses a scoped dynamic cost, so this is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: The Aerie
passive.description: Syl begins the game with 25 Shield. While this Shield holds, Syl will always trigger Two as One when she uses a skill (even if she acts alone).

effect.note: 'Begins the game with 25 Shield' - a round-permanent 25 Shield (The Aerie).

Marks this fused Syl so the innate Two as One same-turn Essence grant is suppressed WHILE her Aerie shield holds (see the base Two as One triggers' shield-gated condition). While the mark + shield hold, essence comes solely from The Aerie's per-skill grant below (no double); once the shield breaks, the base same-turn grant resumes.
While The Aerie shield holds, Syl gains Elemental Essence on every skill use (Two as One's essence gain, even acting alone).

effects.note: 35 Affliction plus Syl's remaining Shield (The Aerie's value, read as Syl's total shield).

'If Syl's Eagle has not used Swoop on that same enemy, Syl dies.' Swoop applies Shatter to its target, so Shatter-on-target is the proxy for 'the Eagle Swooped this enemy'; absent it, Syl dies. No per-target 'Swooped-by-Eagle' marker exists.

passive.name: Flutter in the Fog
passive.description: At the end of her turn, Syl becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. If she became invulnerable this way on her last turn, her Eagle becomes invulnerable for 1 turn instead. The turn after making her Eagle invulnerable, this effect will not activate.

effect.note: 3-state cycle at the end of Syl's turn: (1) Syl becomes invulnerable 1 turn; (2) if she self-invulned last turn, her Eagle becomes invulnerable 1 turn INSTEAD; (3) the turn after making the Eagle invulnerable this does not activate (and marks Syl 'Flutter Inactive' this turn, read by Falling Leaf); then the cycle repeats. turnEnd fires for BOTH teams, so the custom must gate to Syl's own turn-ends; the cross-turn state machine also has no primitive form - custom escape hatch.

effects.note: 40 Piercing. Usable only on the turn Flutter in the Fog is inactive - gated by the 'Flutter Inactive' mark that the passive stamps during its non-activating turn (skill requires).

passive.name: Eaglehawk Rider
passive.description: Using To the Skies! makes Syl invulnerable for 1 turn.

effect.note: When Syl uses To the Skies! (syl3), she becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. No skill-id condition primitive exists to gate a skillUsed trigger to one skill, so this is a custom escape hatch.

effects.note: For 2 turns, if a Shadow Seekers-marked enemy takes NEW damage from Syl or her Eagle, stun its non-Strategic skills for 1 turn (scoped stun, mode 'except' Strategic) and remove the mark. Effects cannot install reactive triggers, so this watch window is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Scavenger's Path
passive.description: Any time an ally or an enemy dies, they create a Scavenger's Pile minion. If Syl's Eagle minion kills a Scavenger's Pile, her Eagle heals 25 HP and Leyline Nest costs 1 less [30] until it is used.

effect.note: Any ally or enemy death spawns a Scavenger's Pile (sylnomadminion) where the unit fell; Piles themselves are skipped to avoid death->Pile recursion. summon cannot place on the dead unit's side nor exclude by template, so custom escape hatch.

If Syl's Eagle (an allied minion, the killer=eventSource) killed a Scavenger's Pile (dead unit=eventUnit, template sylnomadminion), heal the Eagle 25 HP and reduce Leyline Nest's (syl5) cost by 1 until it is used. eventUnit-template tests and scoped dynamic cost have no primitive form, so custom escape hatch.

effects.note: Deals 15 damage to the target (doubles to 30 vs a Scavenger's Pile). If the hit kills the target, the same custom grants Syl's team one Elemental Essence — so kill-essence lives in ONE place (a plain authored `if currentHp==0` grant here would double it now that essence is a countable resource).

passive.name: Stormchaser
passive.description: Leyline Nest's cost no longer decreases by 1 [35] each turn. Instead, its cost is decreased by 1 [35] each time she gains Elemental Essence.

effect.note: Stormchaser replaces Leyline Nest's per-turn decay with per-essence decay. The base per-turn decaySkillCost trigger is now origin 'innate' (so it survives fusion for other forms), so storm permanently suppresses it with this mark — leaving only the per-essence reduceLeylineCostOnEssence below.

Each time Syl gains Elemental Essence, reduce Leyline Nest's (syl5) specific cost by 1 (floor 0). Fusion's replace-semantics already drops the base per-turn decay ('no longer decreases each turn'); this re-homes the discount to essence gains. Skill-scoped dynamic cost has no applyStatus form (StatusSpec carries no skillId), so custom escape hatch.
Leyline Nest's accrued discount resets when it is used (inherent 'resetting on use'); mirrors the base kit's reset trigger, which fusion replace-semantics would otherwise drop.

effects.note: 35 Piercing, Bypassing (piercing dtype + Bypassing tag).

For Syl's next 3 turns, each Skylance (syl2) also deals 5 Piercing to 2 additional random enemies and grants Syl Elemental Essence. Effects cannot install reactive skill-specific triggers, so this window is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Mountain Rescue Team
passive.description: Feed can now target any stunned ally. Swoop can now be used to make a stunned ally invulnerable for 1 turn.

effect.note: Feed (syl1) may now target any stunned ally, not just the Eagle; Swoop (sylminion2) may target a stunned ally to make it invulnerable for 1 turn. Retargeting rules and skill-specific added behaviour have no primitive form, so custom escape hatch.

Re-run after the Eagle evolves: Swoop (sylminion2) only exists on the Adult/Ancient stages, and Leyline Nest's transform mints fresh Eagle skill instances, so the roundStart pass (Eagle is a Hatchling with no Swoop) never patches it. Firing on every Syl skillUsed is idempotent via the per-instance once-guard (Feed stays patched; each fresh Swoop gets the invuln branch exactly once).

effects.note: For the next 4 turns, whenever an ally is stunned, Syl heals them 20 HP and makes them invulnerable for 1 turn. Effects cannot install reactive triggers, so this watch window is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Skyward Shield
passive.description: Stalwart Shield now makes Taryn and any targeted allies Invulnerable for 1 turn, and gives Taryn Elemental Essence.

effect.note: Gate: only when the used skill is Stalwart Shield (taryn4) — skillUsed exposes no skillId Condition, so the id check + the apply must live in a custom. Makes Taryn and any allies Stalwart Shield targeted Invulnerable for 1 turn and grants Taryn Elemental Essence. The base skill's 20 Shield + reflect mark still resolve from the unchanged taryn4.

effects.note: Visible marker for the one-turn pending-strike / counter window.
'The following turn, target enemy will receive 30 Damage.' Guaranteed delayed strike (captures the declared enemy).

For 1 turn: if the target uses a Harmful skill it is Countered and Hand of Michael deals an additional 15 damage. An active cannot install a counter trigger, and a counter feeding a scheduled strike's magnitude isn't expressible via effects — custom escape hatch (the +15 is dealt when the counter fires, for 45 total).

passive.name: Flow of Inspiration
passive.description: Inspiring Thrust now lasts for 2 turns, and also heals allies who activate its effect for 10 Health.

effect.note: Inspiring Thrust's mark now lasts 2 turns instead of 1. Reuses Ando's Conductive-Combo setStatusDuration escape hatch (re-setting via custom avoids the remove+re-apply that would re-emit statusApplied).

passiveTriggers.note: 'Allies who activate its effect' = an ally uses a new Harmful skill on the Inspiring-Thrust-marked target. Re-authors the base Essence grant (dropped when fusion replaces the base passive) and adds the +10 heal Flow of Inspiration promises. isFaction is relative to Taryn, so eventSource=ally means his team.

effects.note: 'Taryn grants target ally Elemental Essence.'

passive.name: Purifying Shield
passive.description: When Stalwart Shield ends, Taryn and any affected allies are healed 5 health for each enemy effect affecting them.

effect.note: When Stalwart Shield ends — modeled as Taryn's 20 Shield from it breaking, the closest 'ends' hook (the Shield is round-permanent so it otherwise only lapses at round end) — heal Taryn and any allies still carrying the Stalwart Shield mark 5 HP per enemy-applied effect on them. No Value counts enemy-sourced statuses and a multi-target heal scaled per status isn't expressible — custom escape hatch.

effects.note: 'Cleanses them of one beneficial effect.' removeStatus needs a specific kind and there is no 'beneficial/helpful' status classifier, so a custom strips one enemy-positive status (e.g. a damage_reduction, regen, invulnerable, or other buff).

passive.name: Divine Hymn
passive.description: The Damage Reduction from Protector of the Song now lasts for 2 turns and affects both of Taryn's allies as well.

passiveTriggers.note: Re-authors Protector of the Song: when an ability is reflected to Taryn, 10 DR now lasts 2 turns and also covers both allied heroes; Essence still to Taryn only (prose changes the DR, not the Essence). Gated on eventRedirectedToSelf (the reflect destination == Taryn), exactly like the base passive: fires iff the skill is redirected onto Taryn.

effects.note: 'Target enemy has their Harmful skills stunned for 2 turns' (Harmful-scoped stun). 'This skill is cast in place of Refrain during Radiant Glory' is a base-skill wiring concern (taryn3/taryn4 auto-cast taryn2 under the Radiant Glory mark) that a fusion active's effect tree cannot rewrite — noted, not modeled here.
'If the target receives new damage during this time, the stun will end.' A damage-watch that removes a status isn't installable from an active's effects — custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Forced Harmony
passive.description: If a target affected by Banner of Harmony deals new damage to Taryn's allies, they receive double damage from Taryn's next Inspiring Thrust.

passiveTriggers.note: When a Banner-of-Harmony-marked enemy deals new damage to one of Taryn's allies, flag it with the Forced Harmony mark (until consumed): it will take double damage from Taryn's next Inspiring Thrust. isFaction eventTarget=ally is relative to Taryn.

effect.note: If the used skill is Inspiring Thrust (taryn3 — skillUsed carries no skillId Condition, hence custom), each target carrying the Forced Harmony mark takes an extra 20 (doubling Inspiring Thrust's base 20) and the mark is consumed.

effects.note: 'Deals 15 Damage to target enemy for the next 2 turns' — a 15-per-turn, 2-tick DoT (normal damage).
'During this time, the target is Isolated.'

passive.name: Refracted Refrain
passive.description: Healing from Refrain now affects Taryn's entire team.

passiveTriggers.note: Re-authors Refrain's heal (dropped when fusion replaces the base passive), now team-wide: whenever a Refrain-marked ally uses a skill, all of Taryn's living heroes heal 15 instead of only the mark-bearer.

effects.note: 'Target ally gains 20 Shield. If the targeted ally is affected by Refrain, this skill will affect all allies. This extra effect ignores Isolation.' The team-wide branch is an effect-level grant (not a per-target Helpful skill selection), so it inherently ignores Isolation.

passive.name: Guardian at the Gates
passive.description: Protector of the Song now activates every turn. This effect is disabled for 1 turn if Taryn deals damage.

passiveTriggers.note: Protector of the Song now auto-activates each turn (10 DR for 1 turn + Essence) rather than only on a reflect. turnStart fires for BOTH teams — the engine cannot scope it to Taryn's own turn only, so it may also grant on the enemy turn (accepted limitation). Suppressed while the Guardian Suppressed mark is present.

If Taryn deals damage, disable the every-turn activation for 1 turn. Banner of Consecration's 10 retaliation is exempt — its custom deals damage that does not set this mark ('will not disable Guardian at the Gates').

effects.note: Two-turn retaliation-aura marker on Taryn and his allies.

'For 2 turns, damaging Taryn or his allies will cause the attacker to receive 10 damage. This damage will not disable Guardian at the Gates.' A damage-triggered team retaliation aura installed by an active isn't expressible via effects (no in-effect trigger install), and the retaliation must be flagged not to set the Guardian Suppressed mark — custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Wingman
passive.description: Stalwart Shield no longer grants Taryn Shield, is fully Invisible, and reflects skills back at their user instead.

passiveTriggers.note: Wingman: a Harmful skill declared against a Stalwart-Shield-protected ally is now reflected back at its USER (redirectTo eventSource) instead of onto Taryn. Re-authors the base Stalwart Shield reflect with a different destination. Debt: 'no longer grants Taryn Shield' can't be undone from a passive (the 20 Shield is baked into taryn4's effect tree), and 'fully Invisible' is the deferred cosmetic isHidden flag.

effects.note: One-turn protection marker on the target ally.

'Taryn reflects all harmful skills from target ally to himself for 1 turn.' A reflect window installed by an active isn't expressible via effects (mirrors Ando's oppositesAttract) — custom escape hatch. 'This skill is invisible' is the deferred cosmetic isHidden flag.

passive.name: Glorious Justice
passive.description: If Taryn's team has fewer living Heroes than the enemy team, his skills deal 10 additional damage and have their damage changed to Piercing.

then.note: No status converts a unit's outgoing damage TYPE to Piercing; applies a self flag the damage pipeline reads for 1 turn.

effect.note: While Taryn's team has fewer living heroes than the enemy team, +10 outgoing damage and his damage becomes Piercing; cleared otherwise. Re-evaluated each turnStart (fires for BOTH teams). removeStatus-then-apply keeps a single +10 instance rather than stacking one per turn.

effects.note: 'Stuns Taryn ... for 1 turn.'
'... and target enemy for 1 turn.'

'If Taryn receives new damage during this time, Restrain will permanently last 1 turn longer on the damaging enemy.' A damage-watch that extends a status on the damager isn't installable from an active's effects — custom escape hatch (adds +1 stun duration to whoever damages Taryn within the window).

passive.name: Flag of Inquisition
passive.description: Protector of the Song no longer gives Taryn Damage Reduction, instead increasing his damage by 10 until the end of his next turn. This effect can stack.

passiveTriggers.note: Re-authors Protector of the Song: on an ability reflected to Taryn, gain +10 outgoing damage until the end of his next turn. 'This effect can stack' -> stacks:true ACCUMULATES the magnitude (+10 -> +20 -> ...) across reflects instead of refreshing to +10 (same fix as Ando's God of Thunder). Essence retained (prose changes only the DR). Gated on eventRedirectedToSelf (the reflect destination == Taryn), exactly like the base passive.

effects.note: 'Taryn activates Protector of the Song' — in the zealot form that is Flag of Inquisition's benefit: +10 outgoing damage until end of his next turn.
Protector of the Song also grants Elemental Essence.
Window marker for the Banner-affects-all-enemies clause.

'Until the end of his next turn, Banner of Harmony will affect all enemies.' No single->all targeting-widen primitive exists (only the mark-gated all->single narrow), so a custom widens taryn1's targeting while the Verse of Accusation window is open.

passive.name: Capricious Cornucopia
passive.description: When Titania uses Prance, Gift from the Fae changes to its beneficial version. When she uses a harmful skill on an enemy, it changes to its harmful version.

passiveTriggers.note: 'When Titania uses Prance' -> sets Gift from the Fae to its beneficial version (clears the Gift Malice flag). Prance is detected declaratively via the 'Prance Watch' mark that base Prance (titania4) applies to Titania on use; statusApplied of that mark is the reactive hook.

'When she uses a harmful skill on an enemy' -> sets Gift to its harmful version (the permanent Gift Malice flag). skillUsed carries no class tags, so 'harmful' is approximated as 'a skill whose target is an enemy' (her self-targeted Strategic skills Prance/Summer Clique target self, so they do not flip it; beneficial Gift on an ally does not flip it either).

then.note: Harmful version: for the next 3 turns, any healing the target would receive is instead dealt to them as Affliction damage. No status kind converts heal->damage (heal_lock only blocks healing), so this is a custom escape hatch; the Cursed Gift mark makes the window visible.

effects.note: Branch on the Gift Malice mark set by Capricious Cornucopia. Beneficial (default/no mark, 'starts the game in its beneficial form'): a 20 HP/turn regen for 2 turns. Harmful (mark present): the heal->affliction conversion for 3 turns.

passive.name: Sealed Fate
passive.description: Damage from Thorn Prick or its periodic effect will instantly kill minions if their HP falls below 20 from the hit.

effect.note: Only damage from Thorn Prick's initial hit (titania1) or its named 'Thorn Prick' affliction DoT should execute a minion left below 20 HP by the hit. damageDealt exposes no source-skill/dot-name condition in the DSL, so the source match and the post-hit HP<20 check both live in the handler (which defeats the minion).

effects.note: For 1 turn, watch the target enemy: if it receives any healing, it PERMANENTLY ignores healing (heal_lock, duration null) and takes 15 Affliction damage each turn for the rest of the round (a 15-magnitude affliction DoT, duration null). A trap conditional on receiving healing within a window can't be a declarative effect, so this is a custom escape hatch. The skill is invisible (frozen hidden:true).

passive.name: Arcadian Advancement
passive.description: Each time an ally triggers Prance, Titania's effects will permanently last an additional turn.

effect.name: Arcadian Advancement
effect.note: Each Arcadian Advancement stack extends every non-round-permanent status Titania applies by +1 turn: buildStatus adds stackCount('Arcadian Advancement') of the caster to each applied duration (null/round-permanent untouched; zero for any other caster, so it is self-gating to Titania).

passiveTriggers.note: 'Each time an ally triggers Prance' = the moment an allied hero is the first unit to use a new skill on Titania while her Prance Watch mark is up (the same condition base Prance uses to grant Elemental Essence), gated to allies. Ordering caveat: base Prance consumes 'Prance Watch' in the same skillUsed event, so this trigger must resolve before that consumption.

effects.note: For the next 1 turn, whenever ANY unit uses a new skill it is replaced by a random one of that unit's own skills, cast on randomly selected legal targets. Rewriting skill selection field-wide is beyond declarative effects, so this is a custom escape hatch; the mark on every unit makes the window visible.

passive.name: Five Plagues
passive.description: Titania begins each round with 5 stacks of Five Plagues. Whenever an enemy receives Affliction damage from Titania, they have a 10% chance per stack to receive a random one of the following effects: skill costs increased by [65] for 1 turn, Shattered for 1 turn, non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn, Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn, Isolated for 1 turn.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Begins each round with 5 stacks' -> clear any carryover and set the Five Plagues counter to 5 at round start.

effect.note: Only Affliction-typed damage should proc (damageDealt exposes no dtype condition, so the affliction check is in the handler). Roll 0.1 x current Five Plagues stacks; on success apply one uniformly-random 1-turn effect: skill costs +1 (cost_mod +1, the [65] energy icon = one energy), Shattered, non-Strategic stun (scope Strategic/except), Strategic stun (scope Strategic/only), or Isolated. Chance-scaled-by-a-stack-count plus a uniform pick over five status applications is a custom escape hatch.

effects.name: Five Plagues
effects.note: 'Removes one stack of Five Plagues with each use' -> decrement the counter by 1.

passive.name: Barren Realm
passive.description: Titania now also generates one stack of Summer Clique any time she takes damage. Whenever she would create a Summer Courtesan, she instead deals 10 Affliction damage to the enemy target with the lowest HP (random if tied). This effect Bypasses invulnerability.

effect.name: Prance
effect.note: 'Generates one stack of Summer Clique any time she takes damage.' Summer Clique summons one Courtesan per accumulated Prance stack, so a 'stack of Summer Clique' is a +1 to that Prance counter.

Hooks Summer Courtesan CREATION (minionSummoned): each courtesan Titania creates (Summer Clique, or the titania4 augment) is deleted on the spot and replaced with 10 Affliction to the lowest-HP enemy (random on ties), Bypassing invulnerability. Deleting frees the minion-cap slot so the next courtesan in the same summon op is still created, making the count equal the would-be (Prance) count.

effects.note: For 4 turns (while the Arcadia, Enraged self-mark is up): Thorn Prick (titania1) costs nothing and its INITIAL damage is +5 (its DoT is unchanged). Skill-scoped cost/damage mods aren't expressible via StatusSpec (no per-skill scope on the authorable status), so this is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Compound Eyes
passive.description: Titania can no longer by Blinded, Stunned, or have her costs changed.

passiveTriggers.note: Titania permanently carries the Compound Eyes mark; Hive Formation can grant the same mark (and thus the immunity) to an ally.

'Can no longer be Blinded, Stunned, or have her costs changed' realized as an immunity-by-immediate-cleanse: any Blind/Stun/cost_mod that lands on a Compound Eyes bearer is stripped the instant it is applied (no per-kind immunity primitive exists). Applies to any unit holding the mark, so Hive Formation allies share the immunity.

effects.note: For 4 turns the target ally gains Compound Eyes (the immunity, via the shared mark). While any ally carries the Hive Formation mark: when Titania uses Barbed Wit (titania3), its Taunt is applied to a random Hive Formation ally instead of forcing the enemy onto Titania. Redirecting another skill's taunt target isn't declaratively expressible, so this is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Summer Queen
passive.description: While Titania has a Summer Courtesan, she cannot be targeted by harmful skills.

passiveTriggers.note: Re-evaluate after Titania acts (e.g. Summer Clique just summoned Courtesans). 'Cannot be targeted by harmful skills' = the invulnerable status (engine: invulnerable blocks NEW harmful targeting). Held while at least one Summer Courtesan minion is alive.
When an allied minion dies, re-evaluate: drop the invulnerability once the last Summer Courtesan is gone.

effects.note: Target Summer Courtesan deals triple (x3) damage this turn. outgoing_damage_mod is an additive delta, not a multiplier, so a true 3x is a custom escape hatch; the Burning Order mark makes the buff visible.

passive.name: Weaponized Mirth
passive.description: Laughing Powder's damage over time is doubled, and when it transfers to a new target, the current target receives 15 Affliction damage.

effect.note: Only when the just-applied status IS the Laughing Powder DoT, set its magnitude to 10 (double the base 5). statusApplied exposes no applied-status-name condition, so the name guard is in the handler (prevents re-bumping when unrelated statuses land on a powdered unit).

passiveTriggers.note: 'When it transfers to a new target, the current target receives 15 Affliction.' The transfer itself (base Laughing Powder: a non-Titania unit using a skill on the holder is afflicted) is restored here because 'replace'-mode fusion filters out the origin-less base spread trigger — so this trigger both re-applies the Laughing Powder DoT to the acting unit (eventSource, the new target) AND deals 15 Affliction to the former holder (eventTargets). The doubleLaughingPowder trigger then doubles the transferred DoT (Titania is the applier).

effects.note: Target enemy is permanently Isolated. While it carries the permanent Hysteria Serum mark, whenever it uses a Helpful skill it takes 20 Affliction damage. skillUsed carries no class tag and effects can't install a standing trigger, so the Helpful-use watch is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Hallucinogenic Spores
passive.description: Enemies affected by Barbed Wit or Laughing Powder have their non-Strategic skill costs increased by [65]. This effect does not stack.

passiveTriggers.note: An enemy afflicted by Barbed Wit (its taunt) or Laughing Powder (its DoT) gains +1 cost ([65] energy icon = one energy) on non-Strategic skills. Non-stacking via the named cost_mod + the not-has guard. Fidelity note: engine cost_mod is an unscoped scalar, so the scope{tag:Strategic,except} records the 'non-Strategic only' intent but is not yet enforced.
Once neither Barbed Wit's taunt nor Laughing Powder's DoT remains on the enemy, drop the Hallucinogenic Spores cost increase.

effects.note: Only enemies currently affected by Hallucinogenic Spores (they carry the Hallucinogenic Spores cost_mod marker) take 10 Affliction/turn for 2 turns. The Bypassing tag / affliction typing carries 'Bypasses invulnerability'.

passive.name: Winter Exile
passive.description: Titania can no longer create Summer Courtesan minions. When she uses Summer Clique, she instead creates Winter Loyalist minions.

effect.note: Titania can no longer create Summer Courtesans; when Summer Clique (titania5) is used it summons Winter Loyalist minions instead (one per Prance stack, same count). skillUsed carries no skill-id condition and this re-templates the base summon, so it is a custom escape hatch.

effects.note: For this turn, watch the target enemy: the first time it receives new damage it is Stunned (1 turn) and the ally who dealt that damage gains Elemental Essence. A trigger conditional on receiving damage (and referencing the damage's source) can't be a declarative effect, so this is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Before I Wake
passive.description: When Enter the Dreamscape ends, affected enemies receive damage equal to the damage they received while it was active.

effect.note: Companion A: xyris2 (Enter the Dreamscape) leaves no namesake mark, so stamp an 'Enter the Dreamscape' mark (duration 2, matching the base 2-turn stun window) on its targets. This is the affected-state the banker and release key off.
Companion B: while a unit bears the 'Enter the Dreamscape' mark, bank every damage instance it takes into a 'Dreamscape Damage' tally (accumulating stack), for the release to pay back on expiry.

'When Enter the Dreamscape ends, affected enemies receive damage equal to the damage they received while it was active.' Fires as the Enter-the-Dreamscape affected-mark expires on an enemy; the handler pays back the 'Dreamscape Damage' tally as un-mitigated (true) damage so the payback equals the damage received. No-ops unless the expired status is the 'Enter the Dreamscape' mark.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Enter the Dreamscape' affected-state is modeled as an 'Enter the Dreamscape' mark on affected units; statusExpired fires per-unit as that mark ends (eventUnit = the affected enemy).

effects.note: 'Deals 15 damage to an enemy affected by Enter the Dreamscape.' The target-legality restriction (enemy must be Dreamscape-affected) is encoded as an if-guard on the 'Enter the Dreamscape' affected-mark.

passive.name: Hypnagogic Curse
passive.description: Xyris now starts the game at 1HP. Damage now heals him, and healing damages him. Xyris will now die when he reaches 100 HP.

effect.note: 'Xyris now starts the game at 1HP ... will now die when he reaches 100 HP.' Sets Xyris to 1 HP at round start and installs the inverted lethal threshold (death at 100 HP instead of 0). No primitive sets a starting HP or an inverted death threshold.

effects.note: 'Xyris and a targeted Hero swap their current HP.' No swap-HP primitive; the handler reads both current HPs and assigns each to the other (cf. equalizeHp, which averages rather than swaps).

passive.name: Dreamform Paradox
passive.description: Whenever Dream Body triggers, the cooldown on Astral Rejection and Somnic Apparition are reduced by 1.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Whenever Dream Body triggers, the cooldown on Astral Rejection and Somnic Apparition are reduced by 1.' The hook replicates Dream Body's condition (a skill hit exactly one unit and that unit is Xyris). Because fusion replaces the base passive, Dream Body's own Elemental Essence gain is preserved here, then the two cooldown reductions are added — Astral Rejection = xyrisdimension1 (this fusion active), Somnic Apparition = xyris4.

effects.note: 'Banished (Stunned, Untargetable, Invulnerable) for 1 turn' — the Banish bundle is the three statuses below.
'This effect cancels any skills that they had delayed.' Clears the target's channeling/delayed-skill status.

passive.name: Dark Arcadia
passive.description: Enter the Dreamscape now affects all living units.

effect.note: 'Enter the Dreamscape now affects all living units.' No DSL primitive rewrites a base skill's target set; this rewires xyris2 (Enter the Dreamscape) to affect every living unit. Installed at roundStart so the modification persists each round.

effects.note: 'Deals 20 damage ... increased by 10 for each hero with Elemental Essence on the enemy team.' Amount = 20 + 10 * (living enemy heroes holding elemental_essence).
'Xyris is healed for 10 HP for each hero with Elemental Essence on his team.' Heal = 10 * (living allied heroes holding elemental_essence; allies includeSelf defaults true so Xyris counts).

passive.name: Darkness and Truth
passive.description: Simulacrums and Dream Reflections ignore counters and stuns.

effect.note: 'Simulacrums and Dream Reflections ignore counters and stuns.' Tags Xyris's Simulacrum and Dream Reflection minions as uncounterable and stun-immune. No standing-property or summon-event primitive exists, so a roundStart custom marks all current and future such minions; stun-immunity has no direct status kind (the handler refuses incoming stun on them).

effects.note: 'creates a Simulacrum minion that possesses their Basic skills ... 30 HP and their specific costs are the same as Xyris's.' Summons the 30-HP Simulacrum, then copies the targeted ally-or-enemy's Basic skills onto it, re-elementing Specific costs to Xyris' current element. No DSL primitive copies a live unit's basic kit onto a summon (cf. cloneCounteredSkillOntoMinion).

passive.name: Captured Humanity
passive.description: Enemies countered by Dream Reflection are permanently Mooncursed. (Mooncursed characters have their Strategic skills stunned, deal 5 more non-affliction damage, and suffer 10 Affliction damage each turn.)

passiveTriggers.note: 'Enemies countered by Dream Reflection are permanently Mooncursed.' On a counter firing against an enemy (counterFired's caster = the countered unit, bound to eventSource), permanently apply the Mooncursed bundle: a 'Mooncursed' mark (so Wild Hunt can find them), a Strategic-only stun ('Strategic skills stunned'), +5 outgoing_damage_mod ('deal 5 more non-affliction damage' — outgoing_damage_mod is normal/piercing-only, matching non-Affliction), and a permanent 10 Affliction DoT. counterFired exposes no 'counterer' selector, so 'by Dream Reflection' is not gated — the Somnic Apparition / Dream Reflection mechanic is Xyris' only counter source.

effects.note: 'Xyris targets all Mooncursed units. For 3 turns, they are Shattered and Isolated. Allied targets deal 5 more non-Affliction damage with new skills.' Iterates every Mooncursed unit on both teams: 3-turn shatter + isolated; allied Mooncursed targets additionally get a 3-turn +5 outgoing_damage_mod (normal/piercing = non-Affliction).

passive.name: Quiet Nightmare
passive.description: Xyris will Silence enemies that he damages for 1 turn.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Xyris will Silence enemies that he damages for 1 turn.' On damage Xyris deals to an enemy, apply a 1-turn Silence to that enemy.

effects.note: 'Paralyzes their cooldowns for 1 turn.' No primitive freezes cooldown ticking (the paralysis status stops the whole unit acting, which is stronger and different); this handler prevents the enemies' skill cooldowns from decrementing for 1 turn.

passive.name: Dream Infiltration
passive.description: Enter the Dreamscape no longer deals damage, but targets all enemies. Xyris's skills Bypass against targets affected by Enter the Dreamscape.

effect.note: 'Enter the Dreamscape no longer deals damage, but targets all enemies.' Rewrites xyris2 to drop its 20 damage and hit all enemies. roundStart so the modification persists each round. No primitive edits a base skill's damage/targeting.

'Xyris's skills Bypass against targets affected by Enter the Dreamscape.' Makes Xyris' outgoing damage piercing (Bypass) against units holding the 'Enter the Dreamscape' affected-mark. No status conditionally converts an in-flight skill's dtype per-target, so this is a custom hook on his skill declarations.

then.note: Summons a Dream Reflection carrying a copy of the target's last-used skill (replacing its xyrisminion1 placeholder), re-elementing Specific cost to Xyris' element. The handler OWNS the summon so it no-ops entirely (skill 'fails', no minion) if the target has not yet used a skill.

effects.note: 'Can only be used on a target affected by Enter the Dreamscape ... will fail if the target has not yet used a skill.' The affected-mark guard encodes the target-legality restriction; only then is a Dream Reflection summoned carrying a copy of the target's last-used skill.

passive.name: Shadow Court Ritual
passive.description: Any time Elemental Essence is gained, Xyris gains 5 Ritual Power. After reaching 75 Ritual Power, all units have their skill cooldowns reduced by 1.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Any time Elemental Essence is gained, Xyris gains 5 Ritual Power.' Tracked as a 'Ritual Power' stack counter (+5 per gain). Hooked on statusApplied gated on the affected unit now holding elemental_essence — statusApplied carries no applied-kind Condition, so this approximates the essence-gain hook (may over-fire when another status lands on an essence-holder). 'After reaching 75 Ritual Power, all units have their skill cooldowns reduced by 1' fires once at the threshold, guarded by the one-shot 'Ritual Unleashed' mark; modifyCooldown -1 with no skillId lowers every current cooldown on all units.

passive.name: Dreams of Power
passive.description: Xyris deals 5 more damage to enemies with Elemental Essence, and gains Elemental Essence when using Harmful skills on them.

passiveTriggers.note: 'Xyris deals 5 more damage to enemies with Elemental Essence, and gains Elemental Essence when using Harmful skills on them.' When Xyris damages an essence-holding enemy: the +5 is delivered as healthLoss (flat, ignores Shield/DR, and emits no damageDealt so it can't re-fire this trigger — cf. Aramao's across bonus), and Xyris gains Essence. damageDealt is the Harmful-skill proxy (skillUsed carries no class tags).

effects.note: 'cancels any cancellable skill they are using' — drops the target's channeling status, cancelling an in-progress cancellable (channeled/delayed) skill.

passive.name: Brush of Wings
passive.description: Elegant Sweep deals 10 less damage, but also heals Zephyrex's team for 10 health.

effect.note: Idempotent skill patch (installed at round start; once fused it persists): Elegant Sweep (zephyrex2) deals 10 less (25->15) and, when it resolves, additionally heals Zephyrex's team for 10. A permanent change to a base skill's damage number and payload is not expressible as a reactive trigger or a status, so it is applied as a patch via the escape hatch.

effects.note: For the 3 turns the Light of Raphael mark holds, Elegant Sweep (a Channel that normally lands the following turn) resolves instantly (channelTurns 0). No primitive toggles a skill's channel/instant state, so the timed window is a custom escape hatch keyed on the mark.

passive.name: Cloud Step
passive.description: Wind Step now lasts an additional turn.

passiveTriggers.note: Wind Step's self damage_reduction lasts one turn longer (1->2). Zephyrex's only DR source is Wind Step (zephyrex4), so reacting to his gaining DR and extending it by 1 is faithful. modifyStatus adjusts the existing status in place (no remove+re-apply), so it does not re-emit statusApplied.

'If Wind Step triggered LAST turn' — promote the Wind Step Window mark to a 'Wind Step Armed' mark at Zephyrex's turnStart. Wind Step is cast AFTER turnStart, so the Window mark is absent at the cast turn's turnStart and 'Armed' only appears on turns AFTER the cast; Waft reads 'Armed' so its 10 Piercing fires next turn but NOT the same turn Wind Step triggered.

skill.name: Waft
skill.note: 'Can only be used during Wind Step' is gated by requires: Zephyrex must currently carry the (invisible) Wind Step damage_reduction, his only DR source. No primitive references another skill's active/cooldown state directly.

then.note: Bypassing per prose: this 10 should land even on Invulnerable enemies. The brief's tag list is [Strategic,Instant] verbatim (no Bypassing tag); piercing already ignores DR.

effects.note: 'If Wind Step triggered LAST turn' -> reads the 'Wind Step Armed' mark, which the Cloud Step turnStart trigger promotes from the Wind Step Window mark only on turns AFTER Wind Step's cast (so same-turn Waft deals 0).

passive.name: Fae Prince
passive.description: Every turn that an enemy Hero doesn't deal damage to Zephyrex, that enemy receives 10 additional damage from Zephyrex's next damaging ability.

effect.note: Per-turn ledger: when an enemy hero deals real damage (amount>0) to Zephyrex, stamp a duration-1 'Damaged Zephyrex' mark on that attacker. faePrinceAccrue reads it at turn-end to skip attackers who did deal damage.

At the end of each enemy Hero's turn, if that hero dealt no damage to Zephyrex during the turn, stock a 'Fae Prince' bonus on them so Zephyrex's next damaging ability against them deals 10 more (accrues each qualifying turn). Needs the per-turn damage ledger and per-enemy bonus tracking; turnEnd fires for both teams, so the handler scopes to enemy heroes on their own turn end.

When Zephyrex's damaging ability hits an enemy carrying the Fae Prince bonus, add 10 (times the stocked amount) and clear it. Adding damage inside a damageDealt reaction and reading the stocked bonus are handled natively to avoid re-entrancy.

effects.note: Increases the damage of the target's next skill used on Zephyrex by 10, non-stacking (the 'Prod' mark guards against re-application). outgoing_damage_mod raises the DEALER's next damage; it is not Zephyrex-scoped, so it is the closest status to 'their next skill on Zephyrex'.

passive.name: Fell Wind
passive.description: Biting Wind now causes health loss, which does not count as any form of damage.

passiveTriggers.note: Re-declares Biting Wind under the Fell Wind rework: when an enemy becomes Invulnerable, Zephyrex inflicts 15 health loss (not damage) on them. healthLoss counts as no form of damage and bypasses Shield/DR/Invulnerability, so it resolves 'first' as the original prose requires.

effects.note: For 3 turns, at the end of each of the target's turns the target becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Each fresh 'becomes Invulnerable' re-application re-triggers Biting Wind (under Fell Wind, 15 health loss). No primitive schedules a recurring end-of-target's-turn effect, so the window is a custom escape hatch; the Soulsteal mark flags it.

passive.name: Winds of Summer
passive.description: Biting Wind and Elegant Sweep now deal Affliction damage.

passiveTriggers.note: Re-declares Biting Wind dealing Affliction instead of Piercing: when an enemy becomes Invulnerable, deal 15 Affliction to them.

effect.note: Idempotent patch (installed at round start; persists once fused): Elegant Sweep (zephyrex2) deals Affliction instead of Piercing. Changing a base skill's damage type is not expressible as a status/trigger, so it is a skill patch.

effects.note: The following turn, Elegant Sweep (zephyrex2) costs 1 less. A skill-scoped cost_mod (magnitude -1, duration 1) expresses this, but the DSL StatusSpec has no skillId field, so the scoped cost_mod is applied via the escape hatch.

passive.name: Wingless Wanderer
passive.description: Zephyrex can no longer be stunned during Elegant Sweep. If he receives a new harmful skill while preparing, he will gain Elemental Essence and reset his use of Perfect Execution.

effect.note: While channeling Elegant Sweep (the 'channeling' status named zephyrex2), Zephyrex cannot be stunned, so the channel cannot be interrupted by a Stun. No stun-immunity status exists (non_damage_ignore would over-broadly ignore ALL non-damage effects), so a targeted stun immunity for the channel window is applied via the escape hatch (idempotent, duration 1).

passiveTriggers.note: 'If he receives a new harmful skill while preparing' = an ENEMY uses a Harmful skill targeting Zephyrex (skillUsed with him in targets: declaredTargetsSelf) while he is channeling Elegant Sweep (zephyrex2). He then gains Elemental Essence and resets Perfect Execution by clearing the 'Perfection Locked' mark (which otherwise disables zephyrex5 for the round). skillUsed carries tags, so eventHasTag Harmful matches (skillGranted carried none and never fired).

effects.note: Channeled strike: Zephyrex marks one enemy; at the end of his next turn he deals 45 Piercing to it UNLESS he received a new harmful skill during the channel (no skillReceived/harmful-grant event exists to gate a plain schedule). 'Enemy players see the effect displayed as Elegant Sweep' is real: the skill-level disguiseAs (zephyrex2) telegraphs the cast under Elegant Sweep's name and stamps its Cleave marks so redactState re-skins them to Elegant Sweep in the opponent's view (cosmetic; the real 45-Piercing mechanic is unchanged).

passive.name: Vacuum Blade
passive.description: Any time Biting Wind or Wind Step triggers, Elegant Sweep permanently deals 5 more damage.

effect.note: As Biting Wind triggers, permanently raise Elegant Sweep's (zephyrex2) damage by 5. A permanent per-trigger change to a base skill's damage number needs a skill patch, hence the escape hatch.

passiveTriggers.note: The Biting Wind half of Vacuum Blade. Fusion replaces the base passive, so Biting Wind's 15 Piercing (when an enemy becomes Invulnerable) is re-declared here so it still 'triggers', and each trigger feeds the +5 Elegant Sweep bump.

effect.note: When Wind Step (zephyrex4) triggers, permanently raise Elegant Sweep's (zephyrex2) damage by 5. skillUsed has no skillId Condition, so the gate (event skill == zephyrex4) is inside the custom.

skill.name: Vacuum Style: Blade Prison
skill.note: As a Channel skill, the 'channeling' status re-runs these effects each turn Zephyrex sustains it, re-applying the Invulnerable+Isolated lock 'as long as Zephyrex channels it' (each re-application also re-triggers Biting Wind).

passive.name: Sand Spectre
passive.description: Zephyrex cannot be chosen as a target by Blinded skills.

effect.note: Permanent self-state: Zephyrex cannot be chosen as a target by skills used by a Blinded caster (Blind retargets at random). There is no status for 'untargetable only by blinded casters' (untargetable/invulnerable are too broad), so it is a custom self-flag installed at round start.

effects.note: If the target becomes Invulnerable during the 3-turn Blind, the Blind is removed. An active's effects cannot install a reactive trigger, so the removal-on-Invulnerable watch is a custom escape hatch.

passive.name: Ominous Rumble
passive.description: Triggering Wind Step marks enemies with Ominous Rumble. Marked enemies are automatically targeted by Arcadian Duet and Jolt, consuming the mark in the process.

effect.note: When Wind Step (zephyrex4) triggers, mark all enemies with Ominous Rumble (skillUsed has no skillId Condition, so the gate is in the custom). Marked enemies are auto-targeted by Arcadian Duet (zephyrex1) and Jolt (zephyrexstorm1) via the autoTargetMark skill flag (scheduler.ts forces a single-target skill onto a marked enemy), and each skill's marked-hit branch consumes the mark.

effects.note: Bypassing (tag): the 20 Piercing lands even on an Invulnerable target.
If the target is affected by Ominous Rumble, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence; the mark is consumed in the process.

passive.name: Cold and Alone
passive.description: Enemies gain 1 stack of Cold and Alone every turn they are Invulnerable or Isolated. Upon reaching 3 stacks, the target is stunned for 1 turn.

effect.note: At the end of each enemy's turn, an enemy that is Invulnerable or Isolated gains 1 Cold and Alone stack; on reaching 3 stacks it is Stunned for 1 turn (and the counter resets). A selector filter matches only one status, so the 'Invulnerable OR Isolated' union plus the 3-stack threshold-stun is a custom; turnEnd fires for both teams, so the handler scopes to enemies and counts on their own turn end.

effects.note: Also hits every enemy marked by Cold and Alone for 35 Piercing. If the primary target also carries the stack it may be included here as well (no union-dedup selector); acceptable per prose 'target enemy, and any enemy marked by Cold and Alone'.

passive.name: Submerged Leyline
passive.description: Zevkir's allies deal 5 additional damage while he Channels Call Tides.

passiveTriggers.note: While Zev'kir Channels Call Tides, his allies deal +5 damage. Applied when he begins Channeling (channeling status lands on self); a permanent named buff removed once Channeling ends (see paired statusExpired). Call Tides Channeling has no numeric duration, so the buff cannot track a remaining-window number directly.
Once Zev'kir is no longer Channeling, remove the ally +5 damage buff. Gated on self no longer Channeling to avoid tearing it down on unrelated status expirations.

effects.note: Normally deals 25 to a random enemy; if used during Call Tides (Channeling) it instead strikes the declared target and deals Piercing damage. Targeting is 'single' so the Call Tides branch has a declared target to hit; the non-Channeling branch ignores it and picks a random enemy per the prose.

passive.name: Atlantean Hymn
passive.description: Allies heal for 5 health per turn during Call Tides.

passiveTriggers.note: During Call Tides, allies regen 5 health per turn. Applied as a permanent named regen when Zev'kir begins Channeling and removed when Channeling ends (paired statusExpired). Call Tides Channeling has no numeric duration, so the regen cannot track a remaining-window number directly.
Once Zev'kir stops Channeling, remove the per-turn ally regen. Gated on self no longer Channeling to avoid removing it on unrelated status expirations.

effects.note: Heals 20, plus 5 per stack of Call Tides currently on Zev'kir.

passive.name: Sanguine Spectre
passive.description: Zev'kir heals for 10 health whenever he deals damage. If he is at full health, he instead gains a stack of Call Tides.

passiveTriggers.note: Whenever Zev'kir deals damage he heals 10; if already at full health (missingHp == 0) he instead gains a Call Tides stack.

effects.note: Zev'kir loses 5 health for each enemy targeted.

The following turn each targeted enemy takes 15 Affliction damage plus 5 per Call Tides stack on Zev'kir. The Call Tides bonus is read when the delayed damage resolves next turn (a snapshot-at-cast reading is not expressible with scheduling + Value refs).

passive.name: Static Maelstrom
passive.description: Channeling Call Tides now changes Zev'kir's costs to Generic, and causes him to deal 10 additional damage with his next ability.

effect.note: While Channeling, Zev'kir's costs become Generic. cost_currency_remap (unscoped — no skillId) makes every one of his skills' Specific cost payable as Generic, which is exactly the conversion.
+10 damage with his next ability (duration 1 approximates 'next ability').

passiveTriggers.note: Applied when Zev'kir begins Channeling Call Tides.

Generic-cost conversion ends when the Call Tides channel ends. The scheduler now emits statusExpired {kind:channeling} at every channel end (interrupt or run-out), so eventStatusKind:channeling fires exactly once when Channeling stops -- no longer the not-has(channeling) proxy that over-fired on any unrelated expiry.

effects.note: If Zev'kir has at least 3 Call Tides stacks, grant the whole team Static Maelstrom for 1 turn (Generic costs via cost_currency_remap + 10 bonus damage), the same pair the passive grants.

passive.name: Freezing Brine
passive.description: Damaging enemies with Riptide adds a stack of Freezing Brine for each stack of Call Tides on Zev'kir. Upon reaching 5 stacks, the enemy is stunned for 1 turn and the stacks are consumed.

effect.note: Only when the skill used is Riptide (base zevkir2): add Freezing Brine stacks to each damaged enemy equal to Zev'kir's current Call Tides stacks; when a target reaches 5 Freezing Brine stacks, stun it for 1 turn and consume those 5 stacks. skillUsed carries no skill-id condition, so the Riptide gate + per-target stacking/threshold are a custom escape hatch.

effects.note: Stunned allies become Invulnerable until their next turn.
Invulnerable enemies are stunned for their next turn.

passive.name: Patient Predation
passive.description: Call Tides will now continue until a new harmful skill is used on Zev'kir. The harmful skill is reflected to its user and Call Tides ends.

passiveTriggers.note: While Channeling Call Tides, the first harmful skill used on Zev'kir is reflected back to its caster (kind:reflect, redirectTo eventSource) and Channeling ends. 'Call Tides will now continue' means his own skill use no longer consumes/ends Channeling; that override of base consumption cannot be expressed with a reactive trigger and is an engine limitation.

effects.note: For its next two turns the marked enemy takes double damage from REFLECTED skills: the mark carries reflectedDamageMult:2, which incomingDamageMult applies only when the hit was bounced by a Reflect (the DeclarationResult.reflected flag threaded through to the DamageInstance).

passive.name: Misty Mire
passive.description: Bubble Prison will now target all enemies, dealing 15 Piercing damage to a random target per turn. This damage Bypasses

effect.note: Only when the skill used is Bubble Prison (base zevkir3): retarget it to all enemies and, each turn of its duration, deal 15 Piercing (Bypassing) damage to a random enemy. Reshaping a base skill's targeting and per-turn payload is not expressible with the effect ops, so it is a custom escape hatch keyed to the Bubble Prison skill id.

effects.note: 15 damage normally; if the target is affected by Bubble Prison (detected via a 'Bubble Prison' mark) it deals double (30) and Bypasses (piercing).

passive.name: Chains of Atlantis
passive.description: Whenever Zev'kir or his allies end their turn Channeling an ability, a random enemy gains a stack of Chains of Atlantis. Enemies marked by Chains of Atlantis receive 5 Affliction damage per stack during each turn of Call Tides.

passiveTriggers.note: At Zev'kir's team turn-end, each ally (incl. self) that is Channeling grants a random enemy a Chains of Atlantis stack. turnEnd carries only team (no unit), so the old sameUnit/isFaction-eventUnit gate was dead; gated with eventTeamIsSelf and a forEach over channeling allies.

During each turn of Call Tides, each Chains-marked enemy takes 5 Affliction per Chains stack. Gated on Zev'kir Channeling. turnStart fires for both teams, so this may tick more often than strictly 'his' turns (event-team-scoping limitation).

effects.note: 30 damage; becomes Piercing while Zev'kir is Channeling Call Tides.
If the damaged enemy is marked by Chains of Atlantis, stun it for 1 turn.

passive.name: Rapid Mutation
passive.description: Zev'kir takes 5 Affliction Damage at the end of each of his turns. For every 15 Health he is missing, Zev'kir has one additional stack of Call Tides

passiveTriggers.note: At the end of each of Zev'kir's turns he takes 5 Affliction damage. turnEnd carries no unit (only team), so it is gated with eventTeamIsSelf — sameUnit(eventUnit,self) resolved to [] and never fired.

effect.note: Zev'kir's effective Call Tides count is increased by floor(missingHp / 15). This is a continuously-read derived bonus (not a one-time grant), which no stack/Value primitive expresses, so it is installed as a custom escape hatch at round start.

effects.note: Grants 10 Shield (lasting 2 turns) for each stack of Call Tides Zev'kir currently has.

passive.name: Stinking Marsh
passive.description: When Zev'kir has no stacks of Call Tides, his skills are treated as though he had two, and deal Affliction damage instead. Whenever Zev'kir uses a skill with 0 stacks of Call Tides, he takes 10 Affliction damage.

effect.note: When Zev'kir has 0 Call Tides stacks, his skills are computed as though he had 2 stacks and their damage becomes Affliction. This conditionally rewrites per-skill scaling and damage type, which no effect op expresses, so it is installed as a custom escape hatch at round start.

Whenever Zev'kir uses a skill while at 0 Call Tides stacks, he takes 10 Affliction damage. The check reads the RAW Call Tides count (the floorZero read-mod makes ref:stackCount report 2, so a DSL '==0' would never fire).

passiveTriggers.note: Whenever Zev'kir uses a skill while at 0 Call Tides stacks, he takes 10 Affliction damage.

effects.note: Zev'kir's costs become Generic for a number of turns equal to the Call Tides stacks consumed. Duration reads the stack count before the consumption below.

Grants the team 10 Shield each turn for a number of turns equal to the Call Tides stacks consumed. No shield-regen status exists, so the recurring per-turn shield is a custom escape hatch; turns read before consumption below.

effects.name: Call Tides
effects.note: Consumes all Call Tides stacks. Their count set the cost_mod and shield-per-turn durations above, which are read before this removal.
